jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Paid Social Lead
jobs.description:
About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The role

We’re looking for a Paid Social Lead to own and evolve Numan’s paid social function. This is not a campaign management role — you will define how paid social drives growth, combining creative strategy, automation, and platform execution across Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels.

You’ll build a creative-first growth engine, scaling high-quality acquisition in a competitive, regulated category.


You'll be:
  • Defining best-in-class approach across Meta, TikTok and beyond
  • Setting direction on asset mix (video vs static), formats (Reels, Stories, Feed), and creative types (UGC vs hi-fi) etc.
  • Developing clear POVs on what works, why, and what to test next
  • Building and running a high-velocity creative system (hundreds of assets/month)
  • Translating performance into actionable creative insights and hypotheses
  • Partnering with creative teams to deliver platform-native, performance-led output
  • Designing workflows to support 1,000+ concurrent ads
  • Implementing modular frameworks (e.g. Hook × Body × CTA for video)
  • Defining account structures for modern algorithmic bidding environments
  • Leading testing across creative, bidding, and landing experiences
  • Scaling efficiently while navigating platform constraints and restrictions
  • Owning how data feeds performance (CAPI, event design, value-based optimisation)
  • Using tools like Motion and BI platforms to identify winning patterns

    • We're looking for someone who has:
  • 7+ years in Paid Social with experience scaling high-spend accounts
  • Strong, opinionated understanding of: Video vs static, UGC vs hi-fi AND Platform-native formats (Meta & TikTok)
  • Proven ability to drive creative-led growth, not just media buying
  • Experience with creative automation, feeds, or templated production
  • Deep knowledge of platform mechanics (bidding, structure, signals)
  • Comfortable with data, attribution, and incrementality

    • It's a bonus if you have:
  • Experience with Smartly.io or similar tools
  • Background in regulated or high-LTV categories
  • Exposure to broader growth channels (PPC, SEO, Display, CRO)
    • Our benefits include...
     
    📈  -  Share options.
    🏖  -  25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan). 
    🩺  -  Health insurance with Vitality.
    🚘  - Electric car salary sacrifice scheme with Octopus.
    🧸  -  Enhanced maternity and parental leave.
    🥳  -  A day off on your Birthday! 
    🐥  -  Nursery benefit provided by YellowNest.
    💼  -  Employee assistance programme (access to therapy, financial planning and discounts).
    ⚖️  -  Generous pension (includes both employee and employer contributions).
    💻  -  Flexible working options, including a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. 
    📚  -  Personal training and development budget via Learnerbly. 
    👟  -  Wellhub membership, giving you access to over 2,000 locations in the UK. 
    🚲  -  Cycle to work scheme.
    🚆  -  Season ticket loan. 
    %   -  Discount on Numan products for your friends and family.
    🤲  -  Paid volunteering days. 
    📅  -  An additional 2 weeks off once you reach your 5th anniversary with Numan.
     
    Diversity at Numan
     
    At Numan, people are at the heart of who we are. We recognise and value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring.
     
    We promote innovation and creativity, enabling us to tackle things from various viewpoints and are committed to equal opportunities and continuously strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and valued.
     
    Embracing diversity isn't just our goal; it's our strength, driving us towards a more inclusive future.

jobs.title: Geschäftsführender Partner (m/w/d) Unternehmerberatung im Mittelstand, Nord- und Ostdeutschland
jobs.employer: thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland
jobs.description:
Sie haben als Führungskraft, Unternehmer oder Berater über viele Jahre Verantwortung für Ergebnisse getragen und wollen diese Erfahrung in etwas Eigenes überführen: eine Beratungsgesellschaft in Ihrer Region, mit exklusivem Gebiet, einem erprobten System und Kollegen, die dasselbe tun.

Unter der Marke thexton armstrong laden wir erfahrene Führungskräfte, Unternehmer und Berater ein, als geschäftsführende Partner ihre eigene Beratungsgesellschaft in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland aufzubauen. Sie beraten und begleiten Geschäftsinhaber im Mittelstand, Unternehmen mit 5 bis 250 Mitarbeitern, dabei, ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker, widerstandsfähiger und wertvoller zu machen. Methodik, Werkzeuge, Marke und Einarbeitung sind vorhanden; Ihre Erfahrung, Ihr Netzwerk und Ihr unternehmerischer Anspruch sind der Teil, den Sie mitbringen.

Über thexton armstrong

Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet.

Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf.

Aufgaben

Ihre Perspektive

  • Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland.
  • Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern.
  • Langfristige Mandate aufbauen: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht ein Geschäft mit planbarem Rhythmus. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf.
  • Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation.
  • International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus.

Qualifikation

Ihr Hintergrund

  • mindestens 15 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung, als Geschäftsführer, Bereichs- oder Abteilungsleiter, als Unternehmer oder Mitgesellschafter, als Interim Manager oder Unternehmensberater
  • Führungserfahrung in mehreren Funktionen, etwa Vertrieb, Marketing, Finanzen, Business Development oder Operations
  • nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung von Unternehmensergebnissen, im Aufbau von Geschäftsfeldern oder in der Begleitung von Unternehmen
  • idealerweise B2B-Erfahrung im deutschen Mittelstand und ein Netzwerk in Ihrer Region

Ihre Kompetenzen und Ihre Haltung

  • strategisches und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen
  • unternehmerischer Anspruch mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • die Fähigkeit, mit Geschäftsführern und Inhabern Beziehungen aufzubauen und Vertrauen zu gewinnen
  • die Bereitschaft, die Gewinnung von Mandanten selbst zu verantworten
  • unabhängig, belastbar, an Ergebnissen orientiert, pragmatisch und authentisch
  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (Pflicht), gutes Englisch und Wohnsitz in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland
  • finanziell in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase zu überbrücken und den Ausbau des eigenen Geschäfts zu tragen

Benefits

Warum mit thexton armstrong?

  • Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg unserer Mandate ist durch die Langen Laufzeiten der Mandate dokumentiert auf eine intensive erste Phase von 12 – 18 Monaten folgt eine weniger aktive Phase, die oftmals über Jahre läuft.
  • Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Live und online Onboarding workshops verteilt auf zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung.
  • Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst.
  • Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne zusätzliche Personalkosten, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus.
  • Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund.
  • Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen.
  • Arbeit mit Wirkung: Sie sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsinhaber ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker und widerstandsfähiger führen und dabei selbst mehr Freiheit gewinnen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Es handelt sich nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung.
  • Der Aufbau des Mandantenstamms ist Ihre Aufgabe. Im ersten Jahr steht die Gewinnung von Mandanten im Vordergrund; dafür erhalten Sie von uns ein erprobtes Verfahren, laufende Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung. Die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Phase auf.
  • Die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen der Partnerschaft legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Mittelstands in Nord- und Ostdeutschland mit.

Dies ist mehr als eine Position: Es ist eine unternehmerische Führungsaufgabe mit Wachstumsperspektive für Menschen, die strategische Erfahrung mit unternehmerischer Freiheit verbinden und im Mittelstand ihrer Region etwas bewegen wollen.

Auswahl und Kontakt

Der Weg zu einer Entscheidung führt über ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten), eine Informationsveranstaltung, Gespräche mit bestehenden Partnern und ausreichend Bedenkzeit. Wenn Sie noch angestellt sind: Wir behandeln Ihre Kontaktaufnahme vertraulich und legen Gespräche außerhalb Ihrer Arbeitszeit.Bewerben Sie sich mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben bei Christian von Volkmann, Geschäftsführer der VOVOI GmbH, verantwortlich für thexton armstrong in Nord- und Ostdeutschland. E: , F: 030 90 313 662

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/x) - Mid Level
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur Kampagnen optimieren, sondern Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln, Budgets verantworten und Kunden als echter Sparringspartner begleiten? Dann bist du bei altitude richtig.

Als digitaler Growth Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, Wachstum messbar, effizient und nachhaltig voranzutreiben. In deiner Rolle verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz und arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.

Aufgaben

Performance-Strategie & Wachstum

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam entwickelst du passende Wachstums- und Performance-Marketing-Strategien für unsere Kunden.
  • Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele in konkrete Kanal-, Kampagnen- und Budgetstrategien über relevante Online-Marketing-Kanäle hinweg, darunter Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Native und Programmatic.
  • Du steuerst Budgets kanal- und zielgruppenübergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Maßnahmen effizient auf die definierten Wachstumsziele einzahlen.
  • Du analysierst laufend Performance-Daten, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und passt Strategien regelmäßig an.
  • Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und weitere Anwendungen, um Analysen, Recherchen, Kampagnenkonzepte, Reportings und operative Prozesse effizienter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

Kampagnensteuerung & Marketing Operations

  • Du verantwortest das Setup, Management und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen.
  • Du etablierst Reporting- und Controlling-Prozesse, überwachst relevante KPIs und behältst Budgets, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
  • Du übersetzt Kundenziele in klare Aufgaben für das Performance-Team und gibst strukturierte Briefings.
  • Du bist Impulsgeber für aktuelle Performance-Marketing-Themen, neue Tools und AI-basierte Arbeitsweisen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv im Team.

Kunden, Stakeholder & Zusammenarbeit

  • In Kundenterminen und Jour Fixes präsentierst du Performance-Strategien, Maßnahmen und Ergebnisse verständlich und überzeugend.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass Kunden Anforderungen, nächste Schritte und Performance-Hebel jederzeit nachvollziehen können.
  • Du erkennst Potenziale, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam konkrete Maßnahmen zur Zielerreichung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative Team zusammen, um datenbasierte kreative Konzepte, neue Testansätze und wirkungsvolle Kampagnenideen zu entwickeln.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing gesammelt, idealerweise im Agentur-, E-Commerce-, B2C- oder B2B-Umfeld.
  • Du kennst dich in mehreren Online-Marketing-Kanälen gut aus, zum Beispiel Paid Social, Paid Search, Native oder Programmatic, und hast in mindestens einem Kanal echte Expertentiefe.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Tracking, Reporting und KPI-basierter Kampagnensteuerung.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und verbindest analytisches Denken mit pragmatischer Umsetzung.
  • Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.
  • Du verfolgst Performance-Marketing-Trends aktiv und bringst neue Impulse proaktiv ins Team ein.
  • Du managst deine Projekte proaktiv und selbstständig, findest dich aber auch schnell in Teams ein und schätzt Kollaboration und gute Zusammenarbeit.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, detailorientiert und strukturiert.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und gestaltest Wachstumsstrategien aktiv mit.
  • Interdisziplinäres Expertenteam: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Kollegen aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.
  • Moderne Ausstattung: Technisch aktuelles Work Equipment ist für uns selbstverständlich. (MacBook)
  • Mobilität: BVG-Zuschuss oder Swapfiets-Abo. Du kannst entscheiden
  • Erholung: Wer neue Wege geht, braucht hin und wieder eine Pause. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Eigene Projektverantwortung, große Handlungsfreiheit und der Erfahrungs- und Wissensschatz unseres Teams sorgen dafür, dass du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Desweiteren wirst du regelmäßig an Fortbildungsveranstaltungen teilnehmen, um in der Online Marketing Welt immer auf dem neusten Stand zu bleiben.
  • AI-enabled Workflows: Wir arbeiten aktiv mit modernen Tools und Technologien, um bessere Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer - Freelance (Mid-Level / Senior)
jobs.description:
RoboService solves the "Last Mile" of humanoid robotics. While manufacturers provide the hardware and foundation models, these general-purpose "brains" are not yet ready for the specific, accurate tasks of a production line. We bridge that gap.

We build a stack that is "AI Enabled", but provides safety and reliability through deterministic orchestration.

We are not a research lab; we are shipping code that moves atoms. Launched in July 2025 by repeat founders with successful exits, we are looking for engineers who want to take robots out of the lab and onto the factory floor.

Tasks

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer to build fully autonomous robots. Our tech stack provides a large part of the infrastructure and core components to build reliable automations with Humanoids.

However, each project needs customizations. Your task will be to adjust our tech stack to the specific use case you are working on. Additionally, you will be further enhancing and extending our tech stack.

You won't be writing papers. You will be working on:

  • ROS 2 Development: Develop and integrate ROS 2 packages to enable reliable communication, control, and coordination across robotic systems.
  • Data Pipeline & Imitation Learning: Manage the data pipeline and oversee teleoperation and imitation-learning activities to ensure high-quality training data. Manage large datasets required for model fine-tuning.
  • Reinforcement Learning (RL): Apply RL techniques to fine-tune robot actions, ensuring robust performance on the production line.
  • Simulation & Sim-to-Real: Use high-fidelity simulation environments such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to train and test agents before deploying them to physical hardware.

Requirements

  • Education: BS / MS in Robotics OR equivalent robotics experience.
  • Experience: 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in robotics, deep learning, or embodied AI.
  • Robotics Middleware: Familiarity with ROS2 (Robot Operating System), including navigation, manipulation, and driver integration.
  • Core ML Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX). Experience with Transformers and VLA architectures is highly desirable.
  • Simulation: Some experience with physics-based simulators, specifically NVIDIA Isaac Sim or similar (Gazebo, MuJoCo).
  • Data Engineering: Ability to manage high quality demonstration datasets, automate data cleaning, and build training pipelines.
  • Pioneering: Experience debugging hardware/software interfaces on non-standard platforms.
  • Strong in Python (C++ is a +)
  • Proficiency in English

Benefits

  • Above market salary
  • Access to Cutting Edge Tech: Work daily on the latest software and hardware that will shape our future.
  • Impact: Work in real projects with manufacturers to bring robots onto manufacturing floors.
  • Startup Environment: We are a fast-moving startup with high growth ambitions.
  • Team of Experts: We are a team of experts where every voice matters. Work with professionals that are leading their field.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
BLUE is a specialist global B2B communications consultancy for organisations operating in complex, high-value industries - such as maritime, marine leisure, energy and carbon markets. Since 2008, we've turned market expertise into influence and impact, helping clients lead conversations, shape markets and unlock growth.

Our credibility comes from deep immersion, not observation. We get close enough to our clients' businesses to understand what motivates them, and what keeps them awake at night, so we can operate as true consultants, not just a delivery team. It's why our clients stay, and why we've built long-term partnerships across some of the most complex, high-value industries there are.

The role

We're looking for an Account Manager to become the established day-to-day ‘go-to' for a portfolio of clients, trusted for the quality of your judgement as much as the quality of your delivery. You'll translate agreed strategy into sharp, on-brief tactical implementation, combine PR creativity with sector intelligence to spot the angles that matter, and mentor the Account Executives coming up behind you.

It's a role for someone who wants to be a genuine communications counsel to their clients, a ‘critical friend' who steers activity, not just executes it, while helping to shape BLUE's culture and the next generation of BLUE talent.

Tasks

Client & account management

Writing & content

  • Oversee client social media content across social media, keeping tone of voice on-brand for every client

Team & culture

  • Mentor and develop Account Executives, helping them build their skills and realise their potential as PR professionals
  • Delegate effectively, draft in senior support where needed, and manage upwards to keep every deadline on track
  • Act as a custodian of BLUE's culture, setting the standard for those coming up behind you

Events & business growth

  • Own the delivery of client events and webinars against agreed KPIs, from invitation lists and venue liaison to budgets and on-the-day delivery
  • Spot commercial opportunities within your accounts and flag them to the senior team
  • Contribute to new business pitches, proposals and brainstorms, and help build BLUE's own profile and network

Requirements

Essential

  • Solid agency-side PR or communications experience, with a track record of managing client accounts day-to-day

jobs.title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The Practical Detail
Location: Southwark, London
Working Model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers.

What you'll do

  • Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio.
  • Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements.
  • Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

Performance
You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance.

Care
This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers.

Passion
You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike.

About you
You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING

We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
    • Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
    • Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
    • Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
    • Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud Security 
    • Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
    • Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
    • Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
  • Technology leader
    • Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult's global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
    • Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to  infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
    • Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
  • Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
  • Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
  • Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
  • Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
  • Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In 6 months time…

By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult's infrastructure.

  • Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
  • Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
  • Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
  • Have a full understanding of Catapult's products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.

In 12 months time…

By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult's technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.

  • End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
  • Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
  • Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
  • Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

jobs.title: Media Buyer / Performance Marketer - Meta & Google Ads - (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
150.000 € Werbebudget pro Woche in der Peakzeit. Und der Plan ist, dass es mehr wird.

Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Bis 2030 wollen wir neunstellig sein. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Unsere Meta- und Google-Accounts steuert bisher Antonio, einer der Gründer und Geschäftsführer. Jetzt übergibt er sie. Und zwar an dich. Du übernimmst rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat, in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche), 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Nicht, um den Account zu verwalten. Sondern um ihn profitabel zu skalieren.

Aufgaben

Kurzfassung: Du siehst jeden Tag als Erstes, was im Account passiert, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes kommt. Für den Account. Für die Creatives. Für das Wachstum.

  • Du steuerst Meta und Google täglich: Budgets, Struktur (ABO/CBO), Gebotsstrategien, Kill oder Promote.
  • Du skalierst profitabel. Mehr Spend bei gleichem NC-ROAS ist dein Tagesgeschäft, nicht die Ausnahme.
  • Du fährst Sales-Events wie die Black Week mit sechsstelligem Budget: stündlich checken, intraday skalieren, nachts zurücksetzen.
  • Du liest Triple Whale, Meta, Google, Shopify und unsere Post-Purchase-Survey parallel und weißt, welches Creative gerade trägt und welches Geld verbrennt. Deine Learnings gehen direkt an unsere Creative Strategists.
  • Du testest systematisch: Creatives, Landingpages, Winner erkennen, skalieren, iterieren.
  • Du baust unser wöchentliches KPI-Reporting: Blended ROAS und Shop-Profitabilität über alle Kanäle.
  • Du betreibst unsere Automationen und baust sie mit KI-Routinen weiter aus.
  • Du erschließt neue Kanäle (TikTok, Native, X) und baust sie auf, wenn sie funktionieren.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter. Wir suchen jemanden, der einen großen Account kennt und Bock hat, ihn größer zu machen:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Media Buying bei einer E-Commerce-Brand oder Performance-Agentur, mit eigener Budgetverantwortung.
  • Meta ist dein Heimspiel: Auktion, Attribution, Cost Cap vs. Bid Cap, Neukunden-Ausschluss, Frequenz.
  • Du kennst Budgets, bei denen ein Fehler weh tut: mindestens fünfstellig im Monat, mindestens ein sechsstelliges Sales-Event.
  • Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax) kannst du oder lernst du schnell. Beides ist für uns okay.
  • Du denkst in Zahlen (Triple Whale oder vergleichbar, MER, Post-Purchase-Survey) und triffst daraus Entscheidungen, keine Vermutungen.
  • KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Analysen, Korrelationen, Automationen. Nicht als Buzzword, als Werkzeug.
  • Du bist penibel, aber nicht ängstlich. Skalierung braucht den Mut zu radikalen Budgetentscheidungen.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch.
  • Nice-to-have: Native Ads (Taboola, Outbrain), CRO-Grundlagen und ein Gespür dafür, warum ein Creative funktioniert.

Eine Sache sagen wir lieber jetzt als im Gespräch: Der Account wird jeden Tag geprüft. Auch samstags. Auch sonntags. Ein klassisches freies Wochenende gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht, dafür bist du sonst frei in deiner Zeiteinteilung. Wenn das für dich nicht passt, ist das völlig okay. Dann ist es nur nicht diese Stelle.

Benefits

  • Ein Account, mit dem du wirklich arbeiten kannst: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Tendenz steigend.
  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du fährst den Account eigenständig. Kein Freigabe-Pingpong.
  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Wer die Anlagen dafür hat, wächst bei uns Richtung Senior oder Head of Marketing.
  • Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen).
  • 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von wo du willst, solange du in Europa lebst und erreichbar bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeit: Kein 9-to-5, keine Meeting-Kultur. Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein, solange der Account täglich gecheckt ist.
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Du sprichst mit den Leuten, die entscheiden.
  • Technik-Setup deiner Wahl.
  • Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.
  • Ehrliches Feedback statt Nettigkeiten: Wir sagen dir, was gut ist und was nicht. Das bringt dich schneller weiter als höfliches Drumherumreden.
  • Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann brauchen wir kein Anschreiben, sondern Zahlen.

Zeig uns: Welche Accounts hast du gesteuert, mit welchen Monatsbudgets, mit welchen Ergebnissen (NC-ROAS, MER, CPA)? Welches Sales-Event hast du selbst gefahren? Screenshots dürfen geschwärzt sein, das ist kein Problem.

Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Zahlen, Screenshots, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB).

Wichtig: Bewerbungen ohne konkrete Accounts und Zahlen sortieren wir aus. Wir suchen hier einen Profi, und den erkennen wir an dem, was er gesteuert hat, nicht an dem, was er über sich schreibt.

Wenn du dir vorher ein Bild von uns machen willst: Auf unserer Karriereseite lernst du das Team kennen und siehst, wie wir arbeiten.

Tabea und das Valkental-Team freuen sich auf dich!

jobs.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

jobs.description:
Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens utbildning på IES Hässleholm?

Vi söker nu en lärare i syslöjd och hem- och konsumentkunskap för åk 4-9 med svensk lärarlegitimation. Här på IES Hässleholm får du vara en del av en internationell och trygg lärandemiljö där alla elever står i centrum och får de bästa förutsättningarna för sitt livslånga lärande.

Om oss

Internationella Engelska Skolan har i över 30 år haft en positiv inverkan på sina elevers utveckling. Vi är övertygade om att detta framgångsrika resultat kommer från vårt starka etos, där engagerade och närvarande ledare skapar en miljö där alla strävar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får lärarna fokus på det viktigaste – undervisning och lärande. Eleverna är alltid i centrum, och alla elever är dina elever. Vi tror på värderingar som grund för framgång, och samarbete är en självklar del av vårt sätt att arbeta.

Vad innebär tjänsten?

Tjänsten är på heltid med start vt 2027. Som en del av vårt engagerade arbetslag och ämneslag kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med dina kollega för att verkligen göra skillnad i elevernas utveckling. Vår starka tro på elevernas potential genomsyrar vår undervisning, och du kommer tillsammans med dina kollegor skapa en trygg, strukturerad och utvecklande lärmiljö där eleverna får möjlighet att både utmanas och stimuleras.

I rollen arbetar du nära både lärarkollegor och stödpedagoger i ett nära samarbete, där vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. Du får dessutom ansvaret för mentorskap för en klass, vilket ger dig möjlighet att skapa långsiktiga relationer och bidra till en positiv skoldag.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har svensk lärarexamen i slöjd och hem- och konsumentkunskap, svensk lärarlegitimation. Du är en pedagog med god insikt och förmåga att omsätta läroplanens mål i ditt dagliga arbete. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd och har ett tydligt ledarskap som gör att du står starkt i dina elevgrupper och skapar en positiv lärandemiljö.

För oss är samarbete en nyckelfaktor för framgång, och vi söker därför dig som ser vikten av kollegialt lärande, tydliga rutiner och gemensamma förhållningssätt.  

Du är öppen, kommunicerar på ett rakt och ödmjukt sätt och skapar tillitsfulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Då undervisningen i bild sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi både svenska och engelska, behöver du behärska båda språken flytande i tal och skrift.

Om du är passionerad när det kommer till undervisning och redo att vara en del av ett internationellt team, uppmanar vi dig att ansöka genom att skicka in ditt CV och ett personligt brev till IES Careers,

I tillegg til en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger, tilbyr vi:

  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • En variert jobbhverdag

  • Karriere og utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet muligheten til å søke vår interne Butikklederskole

Vi har spurt våre medarbeidere om hva det er som gjør at de trives i Match:

«Jeg har kjempe gode kolleger, et godt team, og det gir meg energi når kunden blir fornøyd og jeg har en god dialog med kunden. I tillegg får jeg masse energi når mine ansatte forteller at de gleder seg til å komme på jobb.» - Misala, Butikkleder

Receptionist till Hotell Klövsjöfjäll

Hos oss får du jobba på ett personligt fjällhotell i Klövsjö, Jämtland, med fjällen precis utanför dörren och gäster som kommer till oss för skidåkning, golf, vandring, avkoppling, god mat, konferenser och härliga dagar på fjället.

Vi söker nu en receptionist med start redan under hösten, med möjlighet till förlängning över vintern och därefter.

Som receptionist hos oss är du en viktig del av hotellet. Du är ofta den första våra gäster möter och den som hjälper dem att få vistelsen att bli så bra som möjligt. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med in- och utcheckning, bokningar, telefon och mejl, försäljning och att hjälpa våra gäster med stort och smått under vistelsen.

I tjänsten ingår även konferensansvar, där du blir en viktig kontakt för våra konferensgäster och ansvarar för att deras vistelse och arrangemang fungerar så bra som möjligt. Erfarenhet av konferensarbete är därför ett stort plus och meriterande.

Vi söker dig som

    har erfarenhet av arbete inom hotell, gärna från hotellreception
    har god förståelse för arbetet i en hotellreception och de rutiner som hör till
    erfarenhet av konferensarbete är meriterande
    kunskap i HotSoft eller annat bokningssystem är meriterande
    tycker om att möta människor och ge bra service
    är ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och flexibel
    kan arbeta självständigt men också trivs som en del av ett team
    har lätt för att lära dig nya system och rutiner
    behåller lugnet även när det händer mycket

Erfarenhet av försäljning är också meriterande. Du är inte rädd för att se möjligheter, rekommendera det vi erbjuder och bidra till en bra upplevelse för både gästen och hotellet.

Språkkrav

Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, är ett krav för tjänsten.

Boende

Hotell Klövsjöfjäll ligger i Klövsjö, Jämtland, och vi har endast begränsad möjlighet att hjälpa till med personalboende.

Vi hjälps åt

På Hotell Klövsjöfjäll hjälps vi åt mellan avdelningarna. För dig som vill jobba mer och är öppen för att göra flera saker finns därför möjlighet till en större tjänst genom att kombinera reception med arbete i restaurangen.

Vi tror att det blir både roligare och bättre när vi känner till varandras avdelningar och kan hjälpa till där det behövs. Ena dagen kan du stå i receptionen och välkomna våra gäster, nästa kväll kan du vara en del av restauranggänget.

Arbetstiderna varierar och innefattar både dag-, kvälls- och helgarbete.

Kanske är det just dig vi letar efter?

Skicka din ansökan och berätta lite om dig själv och din tidigare erfarenhet.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och kanske välkomna dig till gänget på Hotell Klövsjöfjäll!

jobs.title: Territory Manager , Peripheral Vascular Health
jobs.description:
Medtronic’s Peripheral Vascular Health team supports vascular disease treatment through endovascular and minimally invasive therapies, advancing clinical education, therapy adoption, and patient access across Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

This field-based commercial role is responsible for developing the PVH business within an assigned territory in Norway. The position requires regular customer visits, attendance at procedures, participation in educational activities, and collaboration with Nordic and cross-functional teams. Frequent travel throughout Norway and occasional travel within the Nordic region are required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and some sales experience within medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, or a comparable commercial environment.

  • Experience managing customer accounts and delivering against defined sales or business objectives.

  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly throughout Norway and occasionally within the Nordic region.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the medical device industry, particularly in peripheral vascular, interventional radiology, vascular surgery, embolization, or venous therapies.

  • Knowledge of the Norwegian healthcare system, hospital purchasing processes, and stakeholder landscape.

  • Experience supporting public procurement, tender submissions, and contracting activities.

  • Experience providing clinical, technical, or procedural support for complex medical technologies.

  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals in hospital-based environments.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Territory Manager, Peripheral Vascular Health, you will be responsible for driving business growth, managing customer relationships, and supporting the adoption of Medtronic vascular therapies across your territory. You will work closely with healthcare professionals and internal partners to execute territory plans, identify new opportunities, and deliver commercial and clinical support to customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned with business objectives to drive market growth and achieve sales targets.

  • Identify, engage, and build relationships with key stakeholders, including physicians, nurses, procurement teams, administrators, and key opinion leaders.

  • Grow existing accounts and develop new business opportunities through effective account management and territory planning.

  • Deliver product presentations, clinical education, and technical support to support therapy adoption and customer success.

  • Support procedures and provide product expertise to healthcare professionals when required.

  • Lead commercial discussions and collaborate on pricing, contracting, and public tender activities.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, customer activity records, and opportunity pipelines using company systems.

  • Partner with Nordic colleagues and cross-functional teams to support customer needs, educational activities, and business initiatives.

Vi tilbyr

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Pay range / Rango salarial / Intervalo salarial /Fascia retributiva / Tranche de salaire / Gehaltsband / Salaribereik: Norway: 589,600.00 NOK - 884,400.00 NOK |

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first --- developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

jobs.description:
Vi vill bli världens bästa burgarkedja och vi vet att vägen dit går genom engagerade medarbetare, starka team, grym service och riktigt goda burgare. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass vid varje besök.

Som restaurangbiträde på MAX är du en nyckelperson i vårt dagliga arbete. Tillsammans med dina kollegor ser du till att våra gäster får bästa möjliga bemötande och att restaurangen alltid levererar på högsta nivå. Både när det gäller kvalitet, tempo och service. Du arbetar i team och har varierande arbetsuppgifter: du serverar gäster, håller rent och snyggt i restaurangen, jobbar i köket med att laga burgare och pommes, och ansvarar för kassan där du ser till att gästerna får det som beställts varor. Hos oss är arbetsglädje, gemenskap och utveckling alltid i centrum. Så under dina första dagar lär du dig jobbet steg för steg av din restaurangchef eller en erfaren kollega och på vår lärplattform MAX Academy via digitala utbildningar.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    Servera gäster, ge ett schyst bemötande och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass
    Hålla rent och snyggt i restaurangen
    Laga burgare, smoothies och pommes i köket
    Ansvara för kassan och se till att gästerna får det som beställts
    Arbeta i team och stötta dina kollegor

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Ett fartfyllt jobb i ett sammansvetsat team med mycket goda möjligheter att växa och utvecklas
    Interna utbildningar och tydliga karriärvägar
    Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal samt friskvårdsbidrag
    En arbetsplats där bemötandet, goda burgare, en ren och fräsch restaurang och snabb service alltid står i fokus
    En kultur där vi lägger stor vikt vid hälsa, miljö och socialt ansvar

Hur går processen till?

För våra tjänster som restaurangmedarbetare har vi valt ett enklare och mer relevant sätt att söka jobb. Det betyder att du inte behöver skicka in CV eller personligt brev. I stället får du svara på några urvalsfrågor och genomföra ett Servicetest. Vi rekommenderar att du svarar så utförligt och ärligt du kan på frågorna.

När du har skickat in din ansökan får du ett mejl med en länk till Servicetestet. Testet består av olika situationer som kan uppstå i vardagen på MAX, där du får beskriva hur du skulle agera. På så sätt får du redan tidigt en bra bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss. Testet tar cirka 15 minuter att genomföra.

När vi har gått igenom både din ansökan och ditt test återkopplar vi till dig så snart vi kan. Går du vidare i processen blir du inbjuden till intervju. Om du inte går vidare får du besked via mejl. Vi hanterar ansökningarna löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Observera att Servicetestet är ett obligatoriskt steg i vår rekryteringsprocess och att vi därför inte kan ta kandidater vidare som inte genomför testet.

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Vill du läsa om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter? Gå in på www.max.se/dataskydd

jobs.title: Psykolog
jobs.description:
Habilitering & Hälsa erbjuder specialiserad vård och stöd till personer som har en varaktig funktionsnedsättning; som nedsatt förmåga att kommunicera, se, höra eller röra sig. Målet är att bibehålla och utveckla funktionsförmågan, skapa förutsättningar för en god hälsa och möjlighet att aktivt delta i samhället. Vill du göra skillnad för personer som har en funktionsnedsättning? Välkommen till Habilitering & Hälsa, en del av Västra Götalandsregionen. Tillsammans har vi kraft att förändra.

Habilitering är specialiserad hälso- och sjukvård för barn och ungdomar som har autism, intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, rörelsenedsättning eller förvärvad hjärnskada. Vi ger hälsofrämjande och behandlande insatser utifrån varje individs unika behov och förutsättningar, och har specialistkunskap om hur funktionsnedsättningar kan påverka vardagsliv, hälsa och utveckling.

Beskrivning

Psykologer se hit! Vill du ha ett utvecklande och stimulerande arbete så har vi tjänsten för dig!

Vi erbjuder en högkvalitativ vård och söker därför dig som är legitimerad psykolog. Hos oss kan du få fortbildning och kunskapslyft. Habiliteringens styrka är teamfokuserat arbete och du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor i andra professioner i din närhet men även nära psykologkollegor på arbetsplatsen.

För oss är det viktigt med ett personcentrerat och ett hälsofrämjande förhållningssätt där vi jobbar för att skapa värde för patienten. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med tillgänglighet och ett gott bemötande. För att skapa största möjliga värde för våra patienter behöver vi både bedriva kunskapsbaserad vård och våga prova nya arbetssätt. Arbetet sker i huvudsak i Habiliteringens lokaler men kan utifrån behov förekomma i patientens närmiljö.

Vi har ett nära samarbete mellan våra mottagningar i Skövde och Lidköping och vi söker nu två kollegor där din placeringsort bestäms tillsammans med dig.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker dig som

    vill ha varierande arbetsuppgifter som kan vara både utredande/kartläggande och behandlande, med syfte att ge patienterna förutsättningar för en bättre vardag.

Här kan du få vara med och välja inriktning!

    vill arbeta med att ge patienten och dennes omgivning ökad kunskap om funktionsnedsättningen och dess konsekvenser samt lära ut strategier för att hantera svårigheter.
    vill ha en konsultativ och rådgivande roll till patienten och dennes närmiljö.
    vill arbeta med behandling individuellt och/eller i grupp under avgränsade perioder.

Vi erbjuder dig

    en bra introduktion.
    ett spännande och variationsrikt arbete där du får möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll.
    en god gemenskap i tvärprofessionellt teamarbete.
    kollegial handledning, teamhandledning samt yrkesmässigt utvecklingsarbete.

Verksamheten är positiv till olika former av vidareutbildning såsom psykoterapiutbildning, handledarutbildning och relevanta specialistutbildningar. Inom verksamheten ges möjlighet till behandlings- och utredningshandledning. Handledning till psykologstudenter och PTP-psykologer kan förekomma i verksamheten.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad psykolog och vill vara med och utveckla vår mottagning och verksamhet. Har du erfarenhet av att arbeta med patienter som tillhör habiliteringens målgrupper, intresse för neuropsykologi, förståelse för vad kognitiva nedsättningar ger för konsekvenser i vardagen och erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i tvärprofessionella team kan det vara meriterande.

Vi söker dig som har god förmåga att organisera och strukturera ditt patientarbete samt en bra samverkan med övriga professioner i teamet kring patienten. Du har ett uttalat patientfokus som används i samarbete med patienten i valet av utrednings- och behandlingsmetoder. Du arbetar utifrån vetenskapligt beprövade metoder och klinisk erfarenhet och har god förmåga att organisera och strukturera ditt patientarbete.

Vi värdesätter personliga egenskaper såsom samarbetsförmåga, flexibilitet och självständighet. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. B-körkort är ett krav då arbetet medför resor i tjänsten.

Övrigt

Inom Habilitering & Hälsa strävar vi efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Rekryteringen sker löpande och du kan bli kontaktad innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.

Om Västra Götalandsregionen

Hos oss blir du en del av en större helhet. Vi är 56 000 medarbetare i över 200 yrken som varje dag gör skillnad i människors liv i hela Västra Götaland.

Du bidrar till en trygg och jämlik vård samt till ett hållbart samhälle där miljö, kultur och goda kommunikationer skapar livskvalitet.
