jobs.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

In this Software Engineer role, you will play an important part in the development of a market-leading, open standards first platform, providing flexible, modular and scalable identification, authentication, and authorization to a range of applications. You will be part of a team that prides itself on an open, flexible environment, embracing collaboration, agile methodologies, continuous improvement, and most of all, the love of a challenge. 

We require a passionate developer who flourishes in a fast-moving, agile environment. You must have good communications skills, an outstanding ability to translate requirements and designs to functional Java code, and a strong attention to security, quality, testability and performance.

You Will

  • Work as part of an agile development team to implement the highest quality product features
  • Use AI tooling as a practical part of the engineering workflow to accelerate discovery and delivery
  • Have a voice in working with product management and owners to improve the platform and develop new features for our platform
  • Understand and improve our local and cloud deployments
  • Plan and estimate work to be completed
  • Maintain existing code and resolve reported defects
  • Actively contribute to the culture that makes this such a great team

You Have

  • Strong familiarity with the Java programming language
  • Possess the desire to learn and curiosity to understand how and why things work
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills
  • Ideal candidate must be keen to learn quickly and independently, and be capable of gathering information and understanding complex features and environments
  • Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Familiarity with UI development, using javascript, and the Vue or React frameworks 
  • Experience with development tools, including IDEs, Git, Jenkins, and Maven, Bazel
  • Solid understanding of RESTful web services
  • Experience with identity management technologies and protocols (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, certificate & key management, cryptography, etc.)
  • Understanding of enterprise-scale systems and configurations related to security
  • Solid grounding in modern software engineering practices and design patterns, including the design and implementation of modern web applications

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: People Operations Lead
jobs.description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

  • You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

  • You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems.

  • Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Operations better.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate.

  • Confidence working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech in a fast-moving environment.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

  • A background in accountancy, audit, management consulting or another analytically rigorous environment that has given you strong foundations in numerical reasoning, process, controls or data.

And one thing you won't need?

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

I barnteamet arbetar du med barn och ungdomar som har utsatts för eller upplevt våld. Du tar vid när en utredning har inletts och följer barnet genom hela processen. Du arbetar nära den socialsekreterare som utreder föräldern eller föräldrarna och samverkar för att hålla ihop ärendet. På så sätt får du ett helhetsperspektiv på barnets situation, samtidigt som barnets behov och bästa står i centrum.

Arbetet innebär nära samverkan både inom staden och med externa aktörer, exempelvis öppenvård, polis, Skatteverket och BUP. Arbetet är både strukturerat och händelsestyrt, vilket innebär att du behöver kunna prioritera och anpassa ditt arbete när situationen förändras.

Din kompetens

För tjänsten i barnteamet behöver du vara socionom men vi söker både dig med erfarenhet och dig som är i slutet av din socionomutbildning. För tjänsten i vuxenteamet kan även annan akademisk utbildning vara aktuell tex som beteendevetare.

Du har ett professionellt och förtroendeskapande bemötande och kan tala om svåra och känsliga frågor på ett tydligt och respektfullt sätt. Du har gott omdöme, tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och kan fatta beslut och agera utifrån gällande lagstiftning och riktlinjer.

Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift och har god förmåga att läsa, förstå och skriva myndighetstext. Eftersom resor förekommer i arbetet behöver du ha körkort.

Erfarenhet av socialtjänst eller annan relevant myndighetsutövning är meriterande. Det är också meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete med våld i nära relation, barn eller andra målgrupper i utsatta situationer. Kunskaper om exempelvis SARA, PATRIARK, skyddat boende eller barns rättigheter är ett plus.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss arbetar du i en enhet där vuxen- och barnteamet samarbetar tätt. Det ger dig möjlighet att utveckla och bredda din kompetens inom våld i nära relation.

Du får nära stöd av teamledare, kollegor och specialistfunktioner. Vi erbjuder individuellt anpassad introduktion och extern handledning. Vi arbetar med tydliga strukturer för ärendehandläggning och lägger stor vikt vid kollegialt stöd och samverkan.

Vår verksamhet ingår i Individ- och familjeförvaltningen. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att personer som söker vår hjälp ska få förutsättningar att leva ett självständigt liv fritt från våld.

Här kan du läsa intervjuer med personer som idag arbetar på socialtjänsten https://www.vasteras.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobb-och-karriar/vara-yrken/jobba-inom-socialtjansten-2.html (https://www.vasteras.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/jobb-och-karriar/vara-yrken/jobba-inom-socialtjansten-2.html)

Följ gärna Individ- och familjeförvaltningen på Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iffvasteras/ (https://www.instagram.com/iffvasteras/)

Här blir du en del av något större! Med värme och respekt visar vi handlingskraft i det stora och det lilla. Vi lever vår värdegrund i mötet med varandra och de vi är till för. Varje dag, året runt ser vi till att Västerås fungerar. Tillsammans med dina ca 11 500 kollegor runt om i staden får du Sveriges viktigaste jobb.

Läs mer om möjligheter, karriärvägar och om vårt erbjudande här:
https://www.vasteras.se/jobbochkarriär (https://www.vasteras.se/jobbochkarriär)  

Övrig information

För dig som söker en tjänst till barnteamet genomför vi registerkontroll och du behöver visa upp ett godkänt registerutdrag från polisen.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

I samband med intervju behöver du styrka ditt medborgarskap. Det kan du göra med pass alternativt personbevis tillsammans med ID-handling. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du uppvisa att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

jobs.title: Public Sector Enablement Lead
Senior Research Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. 
 
Research

  • Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods
  • Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients
  • Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality  
  • Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients
  • Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects
  • Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners
Comms and External Engagement
  • Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences
  • Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media
  • Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations 
Supervision
  • Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development
  • Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. 
 
For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59.
 
Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered.
 
Please apply following the link below.
 
Indicative Timeline (please note these dates remain subject to change) 

  • Initial conversation with a hiring manager: w/c 21 September 
  • Interviews: late September – early October 
  • We expect to make an offer to the successful candidate by mid October if not before.

jobs.description:
Raus aus dem Takt, rein in die Wirkung.

Facharzt (m/w/d) für Kardiologie

Über Epidaurus

EPIDAURUS ist eine etablierte Privatpraxis im Herzen Dresdens – mit Kardiologie als Schwerpunkt und einem einzigartigen, interdisziplinären Setup. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2008 erbringen wir evidenzbasierte medizinische Leistungen auf hohem Niveau – mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur Symptome zu behandeln, sondern Gesundheit ganzheitlich zu fördern und langfristig zu erhalten.

Was uns besonders macht, ist unser Praxisverständnis: Privat – und vor allem frei. Wir verbinden moderne Kardiologie mit Prävention, Leistungsmedizin und interdisziplinärem Denken. Als privatärztliche Praxis schaffen wir dafür den nötigen Raum: für sorgfältige Diagnostik, individuelle Therapieentscheidungen und ärztlichen Gestaltungsspielraum.

Die Stelle ist mit 30 bis 40 Wochenstunden vorgesehen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie übernehmen die selbstständige fachärztliche Betreuung unserer kardiologischen Patienten auf hohem medizinischem Niveau.
• Sie entwickeln individuelle, ganzheitliche Behandlungspläne – in enger Abstimmung mit Ihren Kollegen aus anderen Fachrichtungen.
• Sie bauen nachhaltige Arzt-Patienten-Beziehungen auf, sehen den Fortschritt und begleiten Ihre Patienten– durch Zeit, Aufmerksamkeit und persönliche Beratung.
• Sie beteiligen sich aktiv an Fort- und Weiterbildungen – fachlich wie persönlich.
• Sie wirken an der inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Praxis mit.

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

• Eine moderne Privatpraxis mit breitem diagnostischem und therapeutischem Spektrum.
• Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten – nicht am Wochenende, nicht an Feiertagen.
• Ein wertschätzendes, kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien.
• Angemessene Zeit für jede einzelne Behandlung.
• Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Mitgestaltung und fachliche Impulse.
• Unterstützung bei Fortbildungen und Ihrer persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
• Faire Vergütung, orientiert an Qualifikation, Erfahrung und Engagement.
• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen und regelmäßige Teamaktivitäten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme, die wir selbstverständlich vertraulich behandeln.

- Work efficiently under pressure to ensure fast response times and minimal wait for customers

jobs.title: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

jobs.title: FP&A Controller (m/f/d) (Controller/in)

Location: Munich | Full-time | Permanent

About us

At Life Couriers, we understand how important the critical moments in life are.

As the global leader in radiopharmaceutical and stem cell logistics, we have leveraged our experience with some of the world’s most time-critical shipments to expand our services to biopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapies, laboratory specimens, clinical trials, organ transplants, medical devices, and more.

Because we know that a missed delivery can mean the loss of a life. That is why we have built our company culture around one clear priority: patient outcomes. Our employees are committed to improving, enriching, and saving lives through the power of logistics.

To strengthen our Controlling team, we are looking for a FP&A Controller (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible.

Your Responsibilities

- Drive monthly management reporting, business reviews and performance analyses for assigned business units
- Partner with business unit heads as a finance sparring partner, providing financial insights, challenging assumptions and supporting operational and strategic decision-making
- Support budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning processes, including the development and maintenance of financial models
- Analyze business performance and variances, identify key business drivers and translate financial data into actionable recommendations
- Support strategic finance initiatives, including commercial improvement, operational optimization, investment decisions and growth opportunities
- Develop and standardize reporting structures, KPIs and planning processes
- Ensure data quality through validation, reconciliation and continuous improvement of reporting processes
- Build and improve scalable FP&A and controlling processes to support the company’s next stage of growth

Your Profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, business administration, economics, business analytics or a comparable field
- First professional experience in FP&A, controlling, finance, audit, transaction services, consulting or business intelligence
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear and concise business insights
- Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other BI tools highly advantageous; knowledge of LucaNet or Business Central a plus
- Proactive, structured and independent working style with a hands-on mentality, strong ownership and attention to details
- Confident communication and strong business partnering skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with finance teams, business unit leaders and management in an international environment
- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

What We Offer

- A high-impact FP&A role with early responsibility for business unit performance and direct exposure to senior management
- The opportunity to shape finance structures, reporting, and decision-making in a growing and dynamic environment
- The opportunity to leverage and further develop your expertise across business partnering, analytics, strategic finance, transformation topics, and the value creation agenda of a private equity portfolio company
- A collaborative, international team with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
- Flexible working model including home office options and flexible working hours (flextime)
- 30 days of annual leave
- Access to employee benefits such as Wellpass or Sodexo
- A purpose-driven company environment, contributing to meaningful healthcare logistics at Life Couriers
- A modern, supportive workplace where your ideas and impact truly matter

Application

Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to receiving your application!

Please send your complete application (CV, cover letter, references), including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date, to: recruiting@lifecouriers.com (https://mailto:recruiting@lifecouriers.com)

We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
DLG befindet sich auf einer ambitionierten digitalen Transformationsreise und entwickelt sich von einer fragmentierten, historisch gewachsenen IT-Landschaft hin zu einer modernen Architektur, die konsequent an geschäftlichen Fähigkeiten und Unternehmenszielen ausgerichtet ist. Als Enterprise Architect (m/w/d) spielst du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, die zukünftige Enterprise Architecture von DLG zu definieren und starke, unternehmensweite Architekturpraktiken zu etablieren.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Hauptverantwortung für unser Enterprise‑Architecture‑Repository und fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson, die Transparenz über die aktuelle sowie die zukünftige Applikationslandschaft sicherstellt. In dieser Rolle agierst du als vertrauenswürdige Beratungsperson für Group IT und die Fachbereiche und treibst die architektonische Governance, Prioritäten und strategische Ausrichtung voran.

Du leitest Initiativen zur Vereinfachung, Modernisierung und Verbesserung der Interoperabilität in unseren Geschäftsbereichen Landwirtschaft, Tierernährung, Energie und Wohnen – mit einem starken Fokus auf die nahtlose Integration zwischen Anwendungen und unserer unternehmensweiten Datenplattform**.**

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

- DLGs Zielarchitektur und Architekturprinzipien definieren und weiterentwickeln – und sicherstellen, dass sie konsequent mit der Geschäftsstrategie abgestimmt sind.
- Die Modernisierungsreise von Legacy‑Systemen hin zu einer composable Architecture vorantreiben, die auf einer starken Integrationsplattform basiert.
- Eine enge Integration zwischen Anwendungen und Plattformen sicherstellen – einschließlich der unternehmensweiten Datenplattform.
- Architekturprinzipien, Standards und Roadmaps definieren und steuern, abgestimmt auf die strategischen Prioritäten der DLG.
- Datengetriebene Architekturinitiativen unterstützen.
- Architektur-Governance und domänenübergreifende Abstimmung zwischen Group IT und den Geschäftsbereichen fördern.
- ERP‑, Daten‑, Integrations‑, Plattform‑ und KI‑Teams in Richtung der Zielarchitektur begleiten.

Profil

- Umfassende Erfahrung in Enterprise‑, Lösungs‑ oder Domänenarchitektur in großen oder komplexen Organisationen
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder SABSA – und die Fähigkeit, sie pragmatisch zur Erzielung geschäftlicher Ergebnisse einzusetzen
- Tiefes Verständnis von Enterprise Architecture, Integrationsmustern, modernen Plattformen und komplexen IT‑Landschaften
- Erfahrung mit ERP‑Systemen (idealerweise SAP), CRM sowie API‑/Event‑getriebenen Integrationen
- Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise‑Architecture‑Management‑Lösungen, idealerweise LeanIX
- Analytische, strukturierte und pragmatische Denkweise, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte zu vereinfachen
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Dänisch und/oder Deutsch sind ein Plus)

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG übernimmst du eine strategische Rolle mit erheblichem Einfluss auf die zukünftige Digital‑ & IT‑Landschaft. Du erhältst ein klares Mandat, technologische Entscheidungen, Investitionsprioritäten und die übergeordnete architektonische Ausrichtung im gesamten Unternehmen mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem CIO, der Group‑IT‑Führung sowie einer Vielzahl von Business‑Stakeholdern zusammen – in einer Organisation, in der Architektur auf Executive‑Level priorisiert und unterstützt wird.

Dich erwartet ein dynamisches, internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit kompetenten Kolleg*innen aus Architektur, Entwicklung und den Geschäftsbereichen. Zudem profitierst du von einem flexiblen Arbeitsort, mit der Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Fredericia oder Flensburg sowie anteilig mobil zu arbeiten.

Weitere Informationen

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Sales Manager (all genders) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.employer: INFORM Institut für OR und Management GmbH
jobs.description:
Du möchtest Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, ihren Personaleinsatz smarter, effizienter und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten? Als Sales Manager im Bereich Workforce Management gewinnst du neue Kunden und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei verkaufst du keine Standardlösung, sondern begeisterst Entscheider für innovative Software, die komplexe Prozesse nachhaltig verbessert. Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und deiner Leidenschaft für New Business gestaltest du unseren Wachstumskurs aktiv mit. Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Was du bei uns bewegen kannst:

- Du identifizierst und priorisierst geeignete Zielkunden und Marktpotenziale, generierst eigenständig Leads und betreibst aktiv Outbound Sales – insbesondere über Cold Calls, E-Mail und Social Selling – und baust eine qualifizierte New-Business-Pipeline auf.
- Du führst Erst- und Discovery Calls durch, analysierst Kundenanforderungen und identifizierst konkrete Pain Points im Bereich Personaleinsatzplanung und Workforce Management. Auf dieser Basis führst du Consultative-Selling-Prozesse auf Augenhöhe mit Fachbereichen und Entscheidern.
- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Pre-Sales passende Business Cases und präsentierst unsere SaaS-Lösung überzeugend gegenüber Fach- und Führungskräften bis hin zum C-Level.
- Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Prozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern und Entscheidern, führst Verhandlungen und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum Vertragsabschluss – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Pre-Sales, Legal und IT-Consulting.
- Du dokumentierst und pflegst deine Sales-Aktivitäten, verantwortest ein konsequentes Pipeline-Management und baust strategisch nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Gleichzeitig beobachtest du Markt und Wettbewerb und identifizierst neue Vertriebspotenziale.

Was du dafür mitbringst:

Must-Haves:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung sowie Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, insbesondere im New Business.
- Erfahrung in Outbound Sales, Cold Calling, im Verkauf erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte und in der eigenständigen Steuerung des gesamten Sales Cycles.
- Ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und Abschlussorientierung sowie starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, Durchhaltevermögen und Teamgeist.
- Begeisterung für Technologie, Digitalisierung und erklärungsbedürftige Software, Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung und schnellen Einarbeitung sowie zu 1–3 Tagen Reisetätigkeit pro Woche.

Nice-to-Haves:

- Erfahrung im SaaS-/Software-Vertrieb und/oder in Retail, Logistik, Produktion oder Dienstleistung.
- Kenntnisse in Workforce Management, Personaleinsatzplanung oder HR-Tech.
- Erfahrung im C-Level-Sales, mit komplexen Buying Centern und im Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.
- Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, strukturiertem Pipeline-Management sowie der Erstellung und Präsentation von Business Cases.
- Kenntnisse etablierter Sales-Methoden wie MEDDPICC, Challenger oder Solution Selling.

Wie wir deine Arbeit wertschätzen:

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten, Workation, Sabbatical
- Kinderbetreuungszuschuss und weitere familienfreundliche Angebote
- Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und weitere Gesundheits-/Sportangebote z. B. Bike-Leasing
- Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektiven mit vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Vielfältiges, gesundes und bezuschusstes Mittagessen in unserer Kantine
- Großes INFORM-Sommerfest, Betriebs- und Teamausflüge sowie eine Weihnachtsfeier

jobs.title: RF Lab Technician (f/m/d) (Elektroniker/in - Geräte und Systeme)
jobs.description:
For our client, a leading global technology company, we are looking for a RF Lab Technician (f/m/d) in Munich.

Responsibilities:

- Work closely with test engineers, team leads, and international colleagues to support day-to-day lab operations.
- Support and maintain test setup infrastructure for test campaigns and regression testing.
- Perform and document ESD measurements in the laboratory using dedicated ESD test equipment and initiate corrective actions where compliance gaps are identified.
- Prepare boards and hardware for testing and ensure test setups are ready for use.
- Manage the secure storage and distribution of hardware, including maintaining accurate assignment records for test engineers.
- Carry out mechanical modifications and installations of laboratory racks and test systems.
- Install measurement equipment, switches, passive filters, and associated DC, data, and RF cabling.
- Plan, install, and arrange new or enhanced regression test setups in the laboratory.
- Perform functional validation, troubleshooting, and calibration of test setups.
- Coordinate the calibration, repair, and upgrade of laboratory equipment, including hardware and firmware updates.
- Manage annual calibration activities, including preparing devices for on-site calibration or shipment to external service providers.
- Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure smooth and timely calibration services, including capacity planning, scheduling, and quality follow-up.
- Ensure the appropriate DGUV testing of measurement equipment returning to the lab after shipment, while taking relevant EHS requirements into account.
- Coordinate replacement of essential and business-critical equipment during repair or calibration periods.
- Maintain laboratory inventory and ensure availability and quality of required materials.
- Manage lab consumables, including ordering and logistics planning.
- Verify the RF performance of relevant materials, such as dismantled RF coaxial cables, using a network analyzer.
- Support the restructuring and organization of component and hardware storage within the laboratory.
- Support the scrapping and disposal process for end-of-life devices.
- Maintain and regularly update laboratory databases and inventory records.
- Support measurement-device inventory control and reconciliation with SAP documentation for fiscal audits.
- Ensure high data quality for CAPEX equipment by maintaining information such as device location, calibration status, hardware/software options, and business-criticality indicators.

Skills:

- Completed technical education or vocational training in electronics, electrical engineering, communications engineering, or a comparable field.
- Practical experience working with electronic equipment and laboratory/test environments.
- Experience with test setups, measurement equipment, cabling, and hardware installation.
- Basic knowledge of RF technology and RF measurement equipment is an advantage.
- Experience with ESD measurements and laboratory ESD requirements is a plus.
- Good mechanical skills and a hands-on approach to installing and modifying test infrastructure.
- Experience coordinating equipment calibration, repairs, or external service providers is beneficial.
- Familiarity with inventory management, databases, and/or SAP is an advantage.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineers and international teams.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when maintaining technical documentation and inventory data.
- German and English fluent.
- A proactive, solution-oriented, and hands-on working style.

For this role the working contract is done through our agency and is fixed on 1 year with option to be extended/take over.

jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement.
* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.title: KFZ-Techniker/KFZ-Mechatroniker (m/w/d) - Klagenfurt (Kraftfahrzeugservicemechaniker/in)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Möchtest du dazu beitragen, eine Welt mit nachhaltigem Wohlstand zu schaffen?
Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Bewirb dich jetzt als KFZ-Techniker/ KFZ-Mechatroniker (m/w/d) in Klagenfurt. Bei Tesla sind unsere Techniker/innen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt und als Techniker/in trägst du dazu bei, unseren Kunden einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten.

Wir bieten

- Onboarding / Einschulung: Zentralisiertes Onboarding in Berlin für unsere Service Technicians (m/w/d) in EMEA
- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvolt- und Sicherheitsschulungen sowie weitere technische Trainings)
- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen
- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Arbeite an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten
- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, das neben Tesla-Aktien oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm umfasst
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team mit starkem Teamspirit und Zusammenarbeit. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet

Was zu tun ist

- Service, Reparatur und Verbesserung: Mit Tesla-spezifischer Software und fortschrittlichen Tools führst du Reparaturen und Wartungen an allen Arten von Tesla-Fahrzeugen durch. Hochvolt Arbeiten führst du unter Aufsicht durch und deine Arbeit dokumentierst du in WARP und Toolbox
- Qualitätssicherstellung: Wir vertrauen darauf,dass du unsere Fahrzeuge vor der Rückgabe und Vorablieferung sorgfältig prüfst und mit dem höchsten Qualitätsstandards arbeitest
- Teamwork: Innerhalb des Teams und auch teamübergreifend (lokal und regional), tausche dich aus und teile deine Erfahrung, um das Serviceerlebnis weiter zu verbessern
- Entwickeln: Bereite dich auf den Erfolg vor. Unsere engagierten internen Schulungsteams schulen dich in Tesla-spezifischer Technologie und der Reparatur von Elektrofahrzeugen

Was mitzubringen ist

- Technisches Verständnis: Du verfügst über mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Fahrzeugservice und Reparaturarbeiten in der Automobil-, Luftfahrt-, Marine- oder ähnlichen Industrien
- Technische Qualifikation: Du verfügst über eine entsprechende Zertifizierung, um in Österreich Fahrzeugreparaturen durchführen zu können (Ausbildung KFZ-Techniker/in), sowie Hochvolt -Klima -und Airbag Zertifikate
- Gute Kommunikation: Du sprichst und schreibst gut Deutsch und verfügst über Englisch Grundkenntnisse
- Arbeitssicherheit und Verantwortung: Übernimm eine Vorreiterrolle bezüglich Arbeitssicherheit
- IT-Affinität: In einem sich ständig ändernden Umfeld mit neuen Technologien, Softwareapplikationen und komplexen Prozessen fühlst du dich wohl
- Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen
- Berechtigung: Du hast die Berechtigung in Österreich zu leben und zu arbeiten.
- Fahrerlaubnis: Wir setzen voraus, dass du im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B bistFür diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von EUR 42.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. Entsprechende Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation werden zusätzlich beruecksichtigt. Darüber hinaus bieten wir wahlweise das Tesla Aktienpaket oder unser Cash Award an.Du bist begeistert von der Stelle, aber der Standort ist nicht ideal? Schau dir hier alle unsere Stellen in Österreich an: https://www.tesla.com/de_DE/careers/search/?site=AT

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Stelle haben die gleiche Chance unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Orientierung, Alter, Herkunftsland, Behinderung, Veteranenschutzstatus, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen Faktoren, die durch die geltenden US-, bundesstaatlichen oder örtlichen Gesetze geschützt sind.

Tesla engagiert sich übrigens dafür, Chancengleichheit für Menschen mit Behinderungen zu verwirklichen und ihnen dafür angemessene Vorkehrungen zu bieten. Bitte teilen Sie Ihrem Personalverantwortlichen mit, wenn Sie zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Vorstellungsgesprächs eine spezielle Unterstützung benötigen.

Datenschutz hat für Tesla höchste Priorität. Wir integrieren ihn in unsere Produkte und betrachten ihn als wesentlichen Bestandteil unseres Geschäfts. Um mehr über die Daten zu erfahren, die wir im Rahmen Ihrer Bewerbung erfassen und verarbeiten, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzhinweise für Tesla-Bewerber.

Bewerben unter: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/283509?source=BA

jobs.title: Key User / DevOps Engineer (m/w/x) (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Data Analysis & Modelling suchen wir eine qualifizierte IT-Fachkraft.

Als IT Key User bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Data Analysis and Modelling, Process Technology, Software-Design und IT für den Anlagen im Reinraum. Mit den erforderlichen Schulungen und Berechtigungen ist sichergestellt, dass das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig und ohne laufende Unterstützung abgewickelt werden kann.

Was dich erwartet:

- Unterstützung beim Onboarding neuer OT-Geräte, einschließlich Beschaffung, Lizenz- und Accountmanagement, Netzwerkanbindung sowie Umsetzung von IT-Sicherheitsanforderungen
- Unterstützung bei Risikobewertungen sowie der Verwaltung von Zugriffsrechten und Remote-Support
- Sicherstellung von Backups für Anlagen und Daten
- Betreuung des Equipment Managements, einschließlich Netzwerkanbindung, Datenintegration, Standardisierung und Konfigurationsmanagement
- Betreuung des Equipment Managements, einschließlich Netzwerkanbindung, Datenintegration, Standardisierung und Konfigurationsmanagement
- Betreuung des Hardware- und Software-Lifecycles durch Verwaltung von Firmware- und OS-Versionen sowie Koordination von System-Upgrades
- Troubleshooting und Wiederherstellung der Anlagenfunktionalität mittels Images
- Koordination des Incident Handlings mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
- Verwaltung und Pflege des Anlageninventars, der Dokumentation, Wartungsaktivitäten, Lizenzsituation und Lifecycle-Prozesse

Was du mitbringst:

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich IT (Informatik HTL, Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung
- Kommunikationsstärke als Schnittstelle zwischen Data Analysis and Modeling, Process Technology, Software-Design und IT
- Technisches Verständnis für IT-Systeme, Software und Produktionsanlagen
- Erfahrung im Troubleshooting und in der systematischen Fehleranalyse
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Gehalt:

Übers Gehalt sprechen wir am liebsten persönlich, aber so viel können wir schonmal verraten: Wir orientieren uns selbstverständlich an marktüblichen Gehältern - das heißt, abhängig von der Position und Ausbildung ist bereits beim Einstieg eine Überbezahlung zum Kollektivvertrag möglich. Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttogehalt von mindestens 47.600EUR. Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung gibt’s entsprechend auch mehr!

DIVŠIĆI 5, 52206 MARČANA

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

  • Posebni uvjeti propisani čl. 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („Narodne novine“ br. 6/2019) te Pravilnikom o izmjeni i dopunama pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („Narodne novine“ br. 75/2020).

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, kontakt telefon/mobitel, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.

  • članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21),

Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni prema odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja i Pravilniku o izmjenama i dopunama pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja koji je dostupan na mrežnim stranicama škole.

Kandidat/kinja prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj je otvoren od 18. rujna do 28. rujna 2026. godine.

Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostavljaju se neposredno ili poštom na adresu:

Osnovna škola Divšići

Divšići 5, 52206 Marčana

(s naznakom: „za natječaj – UČITELJ/ICA NJEMAČKOG JEZIKA“)

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidat/kinja prijavljen/na na natječaj bit će obaviješten/na putem mrežne stranice školske ustanove najkasnije u roku od pet (5) dana od dana odabira kandidata. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, svi će kandidati biti obaviješteni prema članku 18. Pravilnika.

Natječajna dokumentacija neće se vraćati kandidatima/kinjama.

Ravnateljica:

Emilijana Fabijančić, prof.

jobs.title: RADNIK/RADNICA NA ODRŽAVANJU UREĐAJA
jobs.description:
Na temelju Odluke o potrebi zasnivanja radnog odnosa i raspisivanju javnog natječaja broj: 2418/26 od 14.9.2026. godine KD VODOVOD I KANALIZACIJA d.o.o. iz Rijeke, Dolac 14 (u daljnjem tekstu: Društvo), objavljuje P O N O V LJ E N I J A V N I N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto Radnik na održavanju uređaja u Službi uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda, Sektor tehničkih poslova, jedan (1) izvršitelj, na određeno vrijeme radi zamjene privremeno nenazočnog radnika, uz probni rad u trajanju od tri (3) mjeseca. Uvjeti navedenog radnog mjesta: - NKV Opis poslova radnog mjesta:
  • Obavlja pomoćne poslove redovnog održavanja uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda: čišćenje, odmašćivanje, podmazivanje i zamjena potrošnih dijelova.
  • Obavlja pomoćne poslove kod servisnog održavanja strojarske i elektro opreme.
  • Obavlja poslove na uređenju okoliša uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda (čišćenje i održavanje zelenih površina).
  • Izvještava neposredno nadređenog o svim nepravilnostima u radu uređaja za pročišćavanje kao i obavljanju radnih zadatka u svom području rada.
  • Obavlja ostale poslove po nalozima nadređenih.
Kandidati su, uz prijavu na natječaj, dužni dostaviti: - životopis, - dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu (ispis elektroničkog zapisa o radno pravnom statusu ili e-radna knjižica koja se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje) koji između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu i trajanju staža osiguranja, - uvjerenje suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od tri mjeseca). Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (''Narodne novine'' broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na sljedećoj poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-u-drzavnoj-sluzbi/843. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/8 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta oglasa, dostaviti i dokaz o invaliditetu (javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom) te akt iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Rok za podnošenje prijava s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta iznosi osam (8) dana od objave natječaja na Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje i mrežnoj stranici Društva. Prijave se podnose: 1. putem pošte na adresu: KD VODOVOD I KANALIZACIJA d.o.o. Rijeka Ured za ljudske resurse Dolac 14 (III kat) 51000 Rijeka ili 2. na e-mail: posao@kdvik-rijeka.hr. Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi na ovaj natječaj, kao i dokumentacije dostavljene prijavom, u svrhu izbora kandidata. Prikupljeni osobni podaci obrađivat će se u skladu s propisima odnosno s Uredbom (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, br. 42/18). Kandidat koji nije podnio pravodobnu i/ili urednu prijavu (sa svom traženom dokumentacijom) ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njegova se prijava neće razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja pozivaju se na intervju. Kandidat koji se ne odazove na intervju više se neće smatrati kandidatom u postupku. Odluku o izboru kandidata donosi direktor Društva na temelju postignutih rezultata, u roku od trideset (30) dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijave. Protiv odluke o izboru kandidata ne postoji mogućnost ulaganja pravnog lijeka. O ishodu natječajnog postupka svaki prijavljeni kandidat biti će obaviješten na mrežnim stranicama Društva u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata. Društvo pridržava pravo poništenja javnog natječaja u svakoj fazi postupka, bez posebnog obrazloženja i zbog toga ne odgovara za eventualnu štetu.

UVJETI: uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno Zakonu o radu, Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi i Kolektivnom ugovoru za zaposlenike u osnovnoškolskim ustanovama, kandidati moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete određene odredbom čl.105 Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN 6/19, 75/20). Temeljem odredbe čl.105 st.2. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi posebni uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi za osobe koje sudjeluju u odgojno-obrazovnom radu s učenicima jesu poznavanje hrvatskog jezika i latiničnog pisma u mjeri koja omogućava izvođenje odgojno-obrazovnog rada i odgovarajuća vrsta i razina obrazovanja kojom su osobe stručno osposobljene za obavljanje odgojno-obrazovnog rada. Temeljem odredbe čl.105 st.5 Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi poslove učitelja razredne nastave može obavljati osoba koja je završila sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij za učitelje ili sveučilišni diplomski studij za učitelje ili stručni četverogodišnji studij za učitelje kojim se stječe 240 ECTS bodova ili četverogodišnji dodiplomski stručni studij kojim je stečena visoka stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima. Zakona, ne starije od 15 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, ne starije od 15 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja Priložene isprave dostavljaju se u neovjerenom presliku, uz obvezu predočenja izvornika dokumenata na zahtjev. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu o ostvarivanju prava prednosti na koje se pozivaju te imaju pravo prednosti u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji a koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužni su, uz prijavu na natječaja, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja i dokaze (članak 103.stavak 1. Zakona) za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona) Popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka, kao i objavu imena i prezimena na internetskim stranicama Škole sa svrhom poziva na vrednovanje i procjenu kandidata. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidati se neće posebno pozivati te ukoliko ne pristupe procjeni smatrat će se da su odustali od prijave na natječaj. O rezultatima izbora kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru putem mrežnih stranica škole https://os-iver.skole.hr/odluke/ Iznimno, ako se na natječaj prijavi kandidat ili kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima sve se kandidate izvješćuje istim tekstom obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja pisanom poštanskom pošiljkom, pri čemu se kandidate koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima izvješćuje pisanom preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom s povratnicom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta molimo dostaviti neposredno, zemaljskom poštom na adresu škole: „Osnovna škola Iver“ 10361 Sesvetski Kraljevac, M.Halape 8 ili elektroničkom poštom na adresu: osiversesvete@gmail.com, uz napomenu: ZA NATJEČAJ – UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove. Du-Kultur mit Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe

- Gute Kenntnisse in der laufenden Buchhaltung und ein solides Verständnis für buchhalterische Zusammenhänge
- Sehr gute MS-Excel-Prozesskenntnisse sind ausdrücklich wünschenswert
- Gute bis sehr gute Business-Englischkenntnisse
- Interesse an modernen Softwarelösungen und digitalen digitalen Zusammenhängen
- Selbst, strukturierte und genaue Arbeitsweise

Was Sie erwartet

- Eine langfristige Position in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und stabilen Unternehmen

- Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen
