jobs.title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

jobs.title: Business Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

About the Role

The Business Finance Manager oversees the financial planning and analysis processes and requirements for the supported business for Scandinavia. He or she provides financial guidance in compliance with financial policies, prepares management analysis of actual vs. benchmark results, provides business decision support and leads key projects and initiatives to improve financial processes.

The Finance Manager acts as business partner for the Business Unit Director (BUD) and brand teams of the supported business units. The role is focused on Scandinavia but requires analysis and understanding of the three individual markets Sweden, Denmark, and Norway.

Major Responsibilities:

    Strategic decision partnering

- Manage Brand Finance Strategy together with BUD and ad-hoc involvement in key decisions for Brands/Functions

- Provide strategic decision partnering to brand Teams (also engaging with external stakeholders), for example pricing decisions, involvement in new product / indication launches, etc.

- Market & competition analysis in close cooperation with BUD, Mkt.Access, Customer excellence and other stakeholders

- Active Brand Team member, providing suggestions and challenge all Brand related activities

- Financial compliance: Provide Financial Approval on commitments (PO and contracts)

    P&L Management

- Proactively provide suggestions for maximizing revenue and reducing spend across the business

- Manage Brand P&Ls, maintaining an overview of budget and spending (including all planning / LBE cycles and reporting)

- Educate Brand Teams about P&L and encourage ownership, compares demand actuals with forecast and flags deviations to Brand Team and identify causes

    Financial Reporting & Data Interpretation:

- Lead all planning and reporting activities for the brand (LRP, Plan, Update, LBE, S&OP, monthly actuals reporting, …) and works closely with affiliate FP&A team and Area Finance team

- Analyzing variances between planned sales / expenses and actual outcome and supporting the implementation of corrective actions

- Analysis of market & competition data together with CEX, Mkt.Access, Brand teams.

    Demand management: Owns Brand total sales together with Brand Team
    Single point of contact: Provide holistic service to the Brand Team, passing on requests and troubleshooting to the relevant department or link point.

Qualifications:

    Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.  CPA or MBA a plus.
    Minimum 5+ years of progressive and related experience.
    Strong financial, analytical and problem solving skills
    Self-starter with ability to operate independently, drive processes, identify and implement process improvements, establish and adjust priorities to achieve objectives and operate with speed and agility.
    Strong communication skills (verbal and written), with all levels of management and including the ability to listen well and to influence others that do not report directly.
    Proficient Excel skills.
    Knowledge of SAP and TM1 a plus.
    Good reading and writing in both Swedish and English
    Preferred experience in pharma industry or other international environment

jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ 

  • Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
  • Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
  • Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 

Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

  • Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
  • Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
  • Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
  • DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
  • Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
  • Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 

Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

  • Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
  • Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
  • Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
  • Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
  • Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
  • Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
  • Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 

Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

  • Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
  • Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
  • Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
  • Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
  • Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
  • Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
  • Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
  • Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â 

What we Offer:

    • Medical Insurance
    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • Health Care Concierge Service
    • 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax & Roth)
    • Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
    • Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance
    • Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
    • Pet Insurance
    • Milk Stork Program
    • Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges
    • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays)
    • Training & Development

Why KPI Solutions?

At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance.

jobs.title: Bussförare i Tromsø - Norge
jobs.description:
Är du redo för ett nytt äventyr i Tromsø? Bli en del av Tide och bidra till trygga och hållbara reseupplevelser varje dag.

Vill du kombinera ett tryggt jobb med spektakulär natur och oförglömliga upplevelser?
Tide söker både tillsvidareanställda och säsongsanställda bussförare (3-12 månader) till Tromsø, en av Nordens mest unika städer. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en professionell och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samtidigt som du får uppleva midnattssol, norrsken och fantastiska möjligheter till friluftsliv.

Som bussförare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vardagen för tusentals människor. Varje dag ser du till att våra passagerare kommer fram tryggt och säkert, samtidigt som du bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Därför väljer många Tide:
- Fast och trygg anställning hos ett av Norges största bussbolag
- Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal
- Gedigen introduktion och stöd från erfarna kollegor
- Hjälp genom hela processen med förarkort/körtillstånd
- Möjlighet till tillfälligt boende vid anställningsstart
- En trivsam arbetsmiljö med fokus på samarbete och arbetsglädje

Varför Tromsø?
Tromsø kallas ofta för Nordens Paris och erbjuder en unik kombination av stadsliv och storslagen natur.
- Upplev norrskenet under vintern
- Njut av midnattssolen på sommaren
- Åk skidor och gör toppturer precis utanför staden
- Paddla kajak, fiska och upptäck fantastisk natur året runt
- Ta del av ett rikt kulturliv med festivaler, konserter och evenemang

Vi söker dig som har:
- Körkort klass D
- YKB (Yrkeskompetensbevis)
- Körtillstånd för persontransport eller möjlighet att ansöka om detta (Tide kan hjälpa till)
- För att kunna kommunicera väl med passagerare, kollegor och trafikledningen måste du behärska norska, svenska eller engelska på minst B2-nivå.
- Ett tryggt, serviceinriktat och behagligt körsätt

Lön och villkor:
Tide följer Bussbranschavtalet (kollektivavtal).

Genomsnittslönen för bussförare ligger på omkring 603 000 norska kronor per år, beroende på anställningstid, yrkesbevis, kompetens och olika lönetillägg. Utöver grundlönen tillkommer bland annat kvälls-, helg- och skifttillägg samt eventuell övertidsersättning.

Boende vid anställningsstart:
Vi hjälper dig med boende under uppstartsfasen. Under de första sex månaderna står Tide för hyran i ett av våra rum eller lägenheter.

Om du vill bo kvar efter denna period kan du hyra bostaden vidare på egen bekostnad.

Söker du eget boende kan vi även hjälpa till med hyresgaranti, referenser och praktiskt stöd i bostadssökandet.

Vi hjälper dig med körtillstånd:
För att arbeta som bussförare i Norge behöver du ett norskt körtillstånd för persontransport.

Tide vägleder dig genom hela processen, inklusive ansökan, läkarintyg och nödvändig dokumentation. Handläggningstiden hos polisen är normalt mellan 2 och 6 veckor, därför rekommenderar vi att du påbörjar processen så tidigt som möjligt.

Du hittar mer information här: https://jobb.tide.no/jobs/8337235-bussforare-i-tromso-upplev-nordens-paris

In English:
Ready for a New Adventure in Tromsø? Join Tide and help create safe, sustainable, and enjoyable travel experiences every day.

Would you like to combine a secure job with spectacular nature and exciting experiences?
Tide is looking for both permanent and seasonal bus drivers (3-12 months) for Tromsø, one of the most unique cities in Northern Norway.

Here, you will have the opportunity to work in a professional and inclusive environment while experiencing the Midnight Sun, the Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a bus driver with us, you play an important role in the daily lives of thousands of people. Every day, you ensure that passengers reach their destinations safely while contributing to a more sustainable society.

Why Choose Tide:
- Permanent and secure employment with one of Norway's largest bus companies
- Competitive salary through a collective bargaining agreement
- Comprehensive training and support from experienced colleagues
- Assistance with the passenger transport licence application process
- Opportunity for temporary accommodation upon relocation
- A positive working environment focused on well-being and teamwork

We Are Looking for Someone Who Has:
- Category D driving licence
- CPC (Certificate of Professional Competence) / YSK for bus drivers
- A Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel) or eligibility to apply for one (Tide can assist)
- To communicate effectively with passengers, colleagues, and the traffic control centre, you must have Norwegian, Swedish, or English language skills at a minimum B2 level
- A safe, service-oriented, and comfortable driving style

Salary and Working Hours:
Tide follows the Norwegian Bus Industry Collective Agreement.

The average annual salary for bus drivers is approximately NOK 603,000, depending on seniority, vocational qualifications, competence, and additional allowances.

The bus industry offers various supplements, including shift allowances, evening and weekend premiums, as well as overtime pay. Salary will vary depending on the shifts worked.

Working hours may include split shifts and work at different times of the day, including weekends and public holidays. Overtime pay and other supplements are regulated by the collective agreement.

Accommodation When You Start:
We help you with accommodation during your start-up period. For the first six months, Tide covers the rent for one of our rooms or apartments.

After this period, you may choose to remain in the accommodation and continue renting at your own expense. Monthly rent typically ranges from approximately NOK 8,000 to NOK 11,000, depending on the property.

If you prefer to find your own accommodation, we can also assist with a rental deposit guarantee, references, and practical support during your housing search.

We Help You Obtain Your Passenger Transport Licence:
To work as a bus driver in Norway, you must hold a Norwegian Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel).

Tide can guide you through the entire process, including the application, medical certificate, and required documentation. Processing times with the police are normally between 2 and 6 weeks, so we recommend starting the process as early as possible.

For more information, please visit: https://jobb.tide.no/en-GB/jobs/8337402-bus-driver-in-tromso

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
Job OverviewJoin ENPULSION as a Customer Success Engineer (f/m/x) and support our customers throughout their spacecraft missions - from pre-sales, to integration and testing, to on-orbit operations. You’ll act as the key technical partner, ensuring smooth product performance, clear communication, and successful mission outcomes in the fast-growing space industry.

Key responsibilities:
• Act as the main point of contact for project- and program management of key customers.
• Analyze customer requirements and develop compliance matrices to ensure alignment with customer needs and expectations.
• Provide technical support to the Sales team.
• Support customers with integration and operation of ENPULSION products.
• Provide technical support in the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT).
• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of ground support equipment.
• Manage and facilitate customer tests and workshops.
• Initiate, actively support and report on non-conformance processes and anomaly reviews in accordance with established processes.
• Analyze and review on-orbit telemetry, focusing on operator command sequences and thruster anomalies.
• Automate telemetry analysis with Python scripts.
• Recommend strategies and operational parameters based on telemetry and product performance.
• Provide on-orbit operations support to ensure products perform optimally in space.
• Deliver clear, concise, and well-written technical documentation.

Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week

Salary : The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2918,14 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Your profile
• Technical or scientific education (FH/University/UAS/HTL), ideally a Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or Mechanical Engineering.
• 3+ years of professional experience in aerospace or a related industry
• Understanding of electric propulsion systems used for satellite mobility is beneficial.
• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).
• Familiarity with space industry standards and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ECSS, ITAR).
• Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong ability to explain complex technical issues to customers clearly and concisely.
• Willingness to travel to customer facilities as needed.
• Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to independent work.
• Passionate about contributing to a fast-growing business and high-performing team.

Why us?At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include:
• 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
• Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
• Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options
• Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
• Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
• Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program
• Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
• FitFabrik Fitness Center
• Airport Health Center
• Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
• VIE Community App for news and deals

About usMeet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy!ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.

jobs.title: Notariatsassistent_in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Notar:innen sind moderne Rechtsdienstleister mit langer Tradition. Bei Rechtsfragen zu den Themen Vorsorge, Immobilien oder Unternehmen unterstützen Notar:innen.

Unparteilichkeit und ausgleichende Rechtsberatung sind für ihre Arbeit ausschlaggebend.

Ein zentraler Arbeitsbereich von Notar:innen ist die Berarbeitung von Verlassenschaften als Gerichtskommissär:innen.

In Österreich beginnt nach jedem Todesfall automatisch ein Verlassenschaftsverfahren. Notar:innen sind gesetzlich beauftragt, dieses Verfahren durchzuführen. Notar:innen arbeiten dabei als Gerichtskommissär:innen.

Gerichtskommissär:innen informieren alle Beteiligten über ihre Rechte und Pflichten. Sie helfen bei der Abwicklung der Verlassenschaft und der Übertragung des Vermögens an die Erb:innen. Gerichtskommissär:innen sind unparteiisch und sorgen dafür, dass der Wille der verstorbenen Person erfüllt wird.

Als Angestellte:r wird Ihre Tätigkeit auch sehr stark durch die Kommunikation mit dem Gericht und den Parteien in Verlassenschaftsangelegenheiten geprägt sein.

Wir erweitern unser Team und suchen 1 Notariatsassistent_in (m/w/d) Vollzeit/Teilzeit für das Notariat Gaming

* Allgemeine administrative und organisatorische Kanzleitätigkeiten von Terminkoordination bis zur Aktenverwaltung

* Persönlicher, telefonischer und schriftlicher Kontakt mit Klienten, Behörden und Gerichten

* Bearbeitung von Verlassenschaftsakten, Vorbereitung von notariellen Urkunden, Schenkungsverträgen, Kaufverträgen, Testamenten, Vorsorgevollmachten, Unterschriftsbeglaubigungen, Firmenbuchsachen, u.a.

Ihr Profil

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (kaufmännische Lehre, AHS oder berufsbildende mittlere/höhere Schule)

* Zuverlässigkeit, Verschwiegenheit, Genauigkeit und Pflichtbewusstsein

* Begeisterung für organisatorische Tätigkeiten

* Freude an Computerarbeit und fundierte EDV-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS-Office)

* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Rechtschreibkenntnisse

* Teamfähigkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft

* Freundliches, gepflegtes Auftreten und höfliche Umgangsformen

Angeboten wird

* Kollegiales und positives Arbeitsklima

* Interessante, abwechslungsreiche und selbständige Tätigkeit

* Individuelle Einarbeitung im Team

* Unbefristetes, krisensicheres Arbeitsverhältnis

* Ortsübliche Überzahlung nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung

* 36-Stunden bis 40-Stunden Woche

Tööülesanded: • Vastad sissetulevatele hinnapäringutele ja muudad need broneeringuteks.
• Haldad olemasolevaid kliendikontosid – oled nende usaldusväärne ja püsiv kontaktisik. • Arendad aktiivselt vanu ja uusi ärisuhteid reisibüroode, reisikorraldajate ja ettevõtetega. • Käid messidel ja ärikohtumistel ning külastad kliente nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. • Planeerid marsruute ja tagad, et iga kliendi transpordilahendus oleks algusest lõpuni sujuv.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Stabiilse töökoha tuntud ja usaldusväärses ettevõttes.
• Iseseisva rolli, kus sinu tulemused on selgelt nähtavad. • Rahvusvahelise kogemuse – kliendikülastused ja messid välismaal. • Konkurentsivõimelise palga – täpsustame vestlusel.

Muud nõuded: Võtab oma töö eest täieliku vastutuse – sinu tulemused sõltuvad eelkõige sinust endast.
On iseseisev – sa ei vaja pidevat juhendamist ega kinnitust, et oma tööd hästi teha. On usaldusväärne ja järjepidev – kliendid teavad, et saavad sinu peale alati loota. Tunneb end mugavalt väljakujunenud süsteemide ja protsessidega töötades. Leiab rahulolu hästi tehtud tööst ja pikaajalistest kliendisuhetest, mitte pidevate muutuste otsimisest. Valdab eesti ja inglise keelt nii kõnes kui ka kirjas – lisakeelte oskus tuleb kasuks. Eelduseks on varasem töökogemus, eelistatult rahvusvaheliste klientide ja ettevõtetega suhtlemisel ning turismi-, logistika- või autorendivaldkonnas.

jobs.title: International Trainee  Fuel Engineer at Forsmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Shape the future of energy.  

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.  

What you will experience  

Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.

Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.

Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

Your role as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

The Fuel Engineering team provides technical expertise within nuclear fuel, control rods and safeguards. The team leads and supports projects related to the reactor core and fuel, including core modifications, fuel repairs, procurement of control rods and nuclear fuel, fuel and control rod licensing activities, safeguards and planning of fuel transport. The work combines technical support, project coordination and long-term development of fuel-related activities at Forsmark Nuclear Power Plant.

As a trainee, you will support both ongoing operational activities and development initiatives. Your responsibilities may include:

Supporting activities related to nuclear fuel

Participating in inspections of nuclear fuel and control rods

Reviewing technical reports, analyses and documentation

Supporting technical investigations and evaluations

Analyzing operational and inspection data

Contributing to development improvement initiatives

Collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders to solve technical challenges

The work is varied and combines technical analysis with practical activities. You may spend one day reviewing technical reports and inspection results, and another day supporting activities in the reactor hall during planned outage periods.

You will work closely with experienced team members and gain exposure to many different parts of the business. The role is particularly suitable for someone who wants to build long-term expertise within the nuclear fuel area and develop as a technical specialist over time.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably within Energy Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline

Excellent written and oral communication skills in Swedish and English

An interest in nuclear technology, energy systems and industrial operations

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

Experience of programming, scripting or data analysis is considered an advantage

Knowledge of MATLAB or similar tools is considered an advantage

Experience from technical projects, laboratory work or industrial environments is considered an advantage

An interest in process improvement and digitalization is considered an advantage

You should also recognize yourself in the following:

You are curious and eager to learn within a specialist field

You take responsibility and approach your work in a structured way

You work well both independently and together with colleagues and stakeholders

You are motivated by solving technical challenges and contributing to shared goals  

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027

Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles

Be fluent in English

Be available for the full-time programme from its start date

Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements

Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.

Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:  

You will be working in the Fuel Engineering team and located in Forsmark, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer  

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

jobs.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Availability: 35-40 hours per week
Working hours: US East business hours
Reporting to: Lead developer

KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month.

Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions.
  • Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices.
  • Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation.
  • Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback.
  • Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards.
  • Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.
  • Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution.
  • Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks.
  • Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team.
  • Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc.
  • Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team.
  • Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP.
  • Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript.
  • Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews.
  • Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks.
  • Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users.
  • Proficiency with spoken and written English.
  • Fluency with Git.
  • Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone.
  • Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply:

  • Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment.
  • Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework).
  • Building user-facing LLM integrations.
  • Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa.
  • Integrating with Stripe for payment processing.

An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.



Benefits

  • Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries.
  • Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change.
  • Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance.
  • Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options.

 

Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only):

  • Health & Wellness: 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%.
  • Work-Life Balance: 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave.

 

*Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

SQL and database design skills, with the ability to model and work with customer and billing data. Demonstrated ability to analyse billing and customer account data, and to identify and resolve discrepancies. Experience designing or supporting automation and analytics dashboards within a billing or finance environment. Strong Excel skills and experience working with billing or invoicing systems. Sound understanding of data accuracy, billing controls, and contractual pricing terms. jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst/Product and Services Management
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst/Product and Services Management Support for a company in Jönköping. Start is November 1st, 13 months limited contract to begin with - possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Jönköping.

Assignment Description

﻿

Be a part of the company's journey to establish the foundation for offering more digital services. For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.

﻿

Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers. You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission. Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.

In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization. You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

﻿

Your future challenge

This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager. This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

﻿

Tasks

• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.

• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.

• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.

• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.

• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.

• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

﻿

Required skills

﻿

• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.

• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.

• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).

• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Jönköping through Incluso. Start is November 1st, 13 months limited contract to begin with - possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Jönköping.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.description:
The role combines pre-sales technical support, solution design, customer training, commissioning, and after-sales support. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, production, installers, and other partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide pre-sales technical consultation and solution design for EV charging, BESS, and PV projects.

· Prepare technical solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions, including:

o System sizing and architecture

o Product selection and configuration

o EV charger, BESS, and PV integration

o Economic analysis to identify cost-effective system configurations

· Support the sales team with technical clarification, project discussions, and the preparation of technical proposals.

· Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations independently.

· Perform or support on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and configuration of EV chargers and BESS systems.

· Provide after-sales technical support, including fault analysis, troubleshooting, and coordination with customers, installers, and internal engineering teams.

· Work closely with R&D and product teams to communicate field feedback and support technical issue resolution and product improvement.

· Travel mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to other Nordic and European markets as required for commissioning, troubleshooting, training, customer visits, and other technical support activities.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation, or another relevant technical field.

· Good understanding of industrial low-voltage (LV) electrical systems, particularly 400 V three-phase systems commonly used in commercial and industrial applications.

· Familiarity with electrical components and equipment such as power cables, circuit breakers, protection devices, energy meters, current transformers (CTs), controllers, switches, relays, and electrical distribution equipment.

· Ability to understand basic cable sizing, electrical connections, power distribution, protection concepts, and equipment interfaces.

· Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, technical documentation, and system diagrams.

· Comfortable working hands-on with electrical and control equipment during testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.

· Able to independently perform basic system checks, equipment configuration, commissioning preparation, and fault diagnosis within the scope of the role.

jobs.description:
Nordec is one of the leading providers of steel structures and façade solutions in Northern Europe. We design, manufacture and install steel structures for demanding construction projects, ranging from industrial facilities and logistics centres to large-scale data centres and other landmark developments.

Barona is recruiting Site Managers on behalf of Nordec. The selected candidates will be employed directly by Nordec in a permanent position.

As Nordec continues to strengthen its presence in Sweden and across Northern Europe, we are looking for experienced Site Managers to lead installation works on demanding construction projects.

This is an opportunity for an experienced site professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with people leadership, customer collaboration and hands-on project execution. In this role, you will be at the heart of project delivery, ensuring that installation activities are completed safely, efficiently and according to agreed quality and schedule targets.

As a Site Manager, you will act as one of Nordec's key representatives on site. You will lead installation teams and subcontractors, coordinate daily site operations and work closely with customers, project management and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

    Leading and coordinating on-site installation activities

    Managing site teams and subcontractors

    Ensuring quality, safety, schedule, cost control and productivity targets are achieved

    Acting as the main on-site contact towards customers and stakeholders

    Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Project Manager

    Resolving operational challenges and supporting efficient project execution

The role requires sound technical understanding, strong leadership capabilities and the ability to maintain productive relationships with customers, partners and site personnel in a dynamic project environment.

What we are looking for

We are interested in professionals who have gained substantial experience in site management, construction management or related leadership roles within construction and industrial projects.

To succeed in the role, you have:

    Several years of experience in site management, project management or a comparable leadership position

    Proven ability to lead teams and coordinate multiple stakeholders in demanding project environments

    Strong understanding of construction processes, site operations and safety requirements

    Experience from large industrial projects, data centres or other technically demanding construction projects is considered an advantage

    Experience of cost control and budgeting

    Fluent English language skills, Swedish is considered an advantage

    A structured, proactive and solution-oriented way of working

Why join Nordec?

Nordec offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically demanding construction projects in Northern Europe. The company is involved in projects that combine engineering expertise, high-quality execution and international collaboration.

As a Site Manager, you will have a central role in project delivery and significant responsibility for driving successful outcomes on site. You will work alongside experienced professionals in an international environment where expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving are highly valued.

The role offers long-term career opportunities within a growing organisation operating across several European markets and project sectors.

jobs.title: Produktionsutvecklare Logistik, Epiroc i Kalmar

Beslutsvägarna är korta och du har goda möjligheter att utvecklas, driva förändring och bidra till förbättrade logistikflöden och automationslösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta del av dina perspektiv och idéer!

Ditt uppdrag Som produktionsutvecklare inom logistik driver du förbättringar och förändringar i våra materialflöden och processer, kopplat till både nya produkter och nya arbetssätt. Ett särskilt fokus i rollen är utvecklingen av vårt höglager, där du är delaktig i införandet av automatiserade lösningar och nya flödesupplägg.

Rollen innebär en kombination av logistikförståelse och tekniskt intresse, där du bidrar till att utveckla både flöden och automationslösningar.

Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:



•    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill vara med och utveckla både dig själv och vår verksamhet. Du har ett intresse för teknik och en förståelse för hur automation, system och logistikflöden hänger ihop.



Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera analys med praktiskt förbättringsarbete. Kanske har du tidigare arbetat i en produktions- eller logistikmiljö där du varit med och utvecklat arbetssätt, drivit förändringar eller deltagit i projekt. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt, gillar att lösa problem och har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika funktioner.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:•    högskoleutbildning inom logistik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande•    erfarenhet av arbete inom logistik, produktion eller projektledning•    god vana av att arbeta i system, exempelvis Excel•    goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



Har du erfarenhet av Lean-arbete eller automatiserade logistiklösningar ser vi det som meriterande.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in an inspiring environment where you can support research and internationalisation? The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) Grants Office is looking for an experienced, skilled, and passionate Research Coordinator who is proactive, well-versed in external funding, and motivated to make a meaningful difference for researchers across the university.

The SLU Grants Office is a unit within the Division of Planning and Research Support. We provide expertise, support, advice, and information on external research funding to researchers, administrators, and university leadership. Our friendly, helpful, and professional team has a wide range of experience and expertise, enabling us to provide strategic and operational support both pre- and post-award. Our work focuses on proposal-writing advice and constructive feedback, budgeting, administration, and project management. We also provide information and capacity-building initiatives. We are currently based at SLU’s main campuses – Alnarp, Ultuna, and Umeå – but we all work to support the entire university.

Read more about the Grants Office at https://internt.slu.se/grantsoffice/.

Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.

Duties:

As our new Research Coordinator, your primary role will be to work with SLU researchers who are leading applications for collaborative grants such as Horizon Europe Pillar II, MSCA Doctoral Networks, and European Partnerships, with flexibility to support other initiatives as needed. You will offer targeted advice and guidance to SLU coordinators during the pre-award phase, assisting with developing suitable concepts, reviewing proposal texts, and recommending improvements. Additionally, you will provide broader support across SLU through outreach, capacity-building and communication efforts.

More specifically, together with colleagues, you will:

    Support researchers applying for external funding, primarily by providing constructive feedback on proposal drafts and helping them craft a clear, persuasive narrative aligned with the scope of the call.
    Disseminate information about future funding opportunities, proactively identify prospective applicants, and encourage them to apply.
    Design and deliver seminars and workshops focused on funders, funding opportunities and proposal writing, and contribute to events co-organised with other units at SLU.
    Provide input on external funding strategies, including those discussed by SLU’s Strategic External Funding Team.
    Represent the Grants Office and SLU at internal and external networks.
    Support SLU Grants Office communications and outreach, including newsletters and web pages, and developing self-help training materials.

This list is not exhaustive and may change depending on SLU and the Grants Office’s needs. Depending on your personal competencies and interests, there is also scope to propose new initiatives and ways of working.

Please note that, due to the nature of the role, occasional domestic and international travel is required.

Qualifications:

Please use your application to demonstrate how you meet the essential and any applicable meritorious criteria listed below. We will place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position.

Essential

    Experience working in research support within higher education or research institutes.
    The ability to understand complex funding calls and applications and to offer straightforward advice and guidance to academic colleagues.
    Experience with Horizon Europe Pillar II.
    Knowledge and understanding of national and international funding sources, including their guidelines and mechanisms.
    An excellent communicator, expressing yourself well in writing and speech.
    Confidence and flexibility of approach, with the ability to work independently and to collaborate with others.
    The ability to prioritise your own workload under pressure and meet set deadlines whilst maintaining a high degree of quality.
    Excellent people skills with the ability to develop professional relationships and networks at all levels within and beyond the university.
    Excellent command of the English language, written and spoken.
    An undergraduate degree.

Meritorious

    Postgraduate education and/or research experience.
    Experience working at research funding agencies or as an expert evaluator for proposals or projects.
    Experience with Marie Skłodowska Curie Doctoral Networks, European Partnerships, and other collaborative funding programmes.
    Knowledge of EU research policy.
    Experience writing or contributing to large research grant applications.
    Experience in outreach and communications, e.g. newsletters, webpages or blogs, or organising events.
    Experience in developing and delivering training sessions.
    Knowledge of how AI may be used appropriately, effectively, and responsibly in the context of research proposal support.
    Knowledge of the Swedish language, both written and spoken (SLU’s language policy requires staff to be able to understand information in Swedish after 4 years of employment).

Interview Process

Stage 1    Online interview in English (approx. 30 minutes) plus a written assignment (max. one hour).

Stage 2    In-person interview in English (approx. 1 hour).

Place of work

Ultuna (near Uppsala), Alnarp (near Lund), or Umeå. The position requires occasional domestic and international travel.

Form of employment

Substitute employment for 2 years, with the possibility of extension.

Extent

100%. Hybrid working is an option (max. 2 days per week).

Starting date

According to agreement.

Application

jobs.title: Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Improve production economics through operational financial analysis



Would you like to support investment and operational decisions through reliable financial analysis? As Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist, you will analyse production, testing and maintenance costs, identify financial risks and model future capacity scenarios. You will help Operations Karlskrona use resources and capital efficiently while NKT expands the cable production required for the green transition.







Translate operational costs into informed business decisions



Working within Operation Analytics, you will examine cost factors across production, testing, equipment, maintenance and material flows. You will connect financial information with capacity, staffing and operational forecasts, while considering energy prices, raw materials, inflation and policy developments. Your findings will support budgeting, forecasting, investment calculations and expansion planning.



Your responsibility will be to:




    Analyse cost factors across production, testing and material flows
    Prepare financial forecasts for capacity, staffing, equipment and maintenance
    Identify financial risks and opportunities within operational processes
    Support budgeting, forecasting and investment calculations
    Provide weekly cost signals and quarterly financial scenarios



The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden, and involves close cooperation with Operations and Finance as well as other operational functions. You will support line organisations in using cost optimisation methods and models. Any travel requirements will be discussed during the recruitment process.





Profile description:

Commercially minded analyst with a practical operational approach



You are structured, curious and able to consider both financial and operational perspectives. You communicate complex findings clearly and enjoy working with colleagues from different functions. You assess assumptions carefully, ask relevant questions and provide balanced recommendations. You also take a collaborative approach to sharing methods and helping operational teams use financial information in everyday decision-making.



You also have:




    Experience analysing operational costs and cost variations
    Knowledge of financial forecasting and scenario planning
    Experience with budgeting and investment calculations
    Understanding of production, testing, maintenance or capacity economics
    Ability to prepare financial decision material from operational data







Support sustainable growth through better resource decisions



We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This position provides opportunities for career development, cross-functional collaboration and continued development of your financial and operational skills in an international environment. You will contribute to investment, capacity and resource decisions while learning from colleagues across Operations, Finance and related functions during NKT’s continued expansion.







“As a leader, I value clear analysis that helps our teams identify capacity constraints early and make well-founded operational decisions,” says Hiring Manager, Magnus Röstlund.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 28.09.2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Dejan Zegarac, Global Talent Attraction Specialist, at Dejan.Zegarac@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.







We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.







Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
