jobs.title: Associate Professor in Materials Science and Photoelectrocatalysis
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a full-time position as Associate Professor in the section of Electrochemistry at the Department of Chemistry.


About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

The research in the Section of Electrochemistry focuses on the materials science and fundamental understanding of electrochemical processes, and their utilization in sustainable energy conversion technologies. The section is at the forefront of solid-state ionics, particularly in the development of proton ceramic electrochemical cells, including intermediate-temperature fuel cells, electrolysers and membrane reactors. Central research themes include defect chemistry and ionic/electronic transport in materials and at interfaces, and kinetic processes at surfaces. 

This position will be part of a major effort towards development of emerging technologies. This is a joint initiative across several Faculties at the University of Oslo, and in particular related to a research theme on photo-electrocatalysis for clean production of energy carriers and chemicals.

Over the past decade, the research activities have expanded into photo- and electrocatalysis at low and ambient temperature, including CO2 conversion, artificial photosynthesis, and gas-phase (photo)electrochemical cells. These activities build on our long-standing expertise and infrastructure in high-temperature electrochemical systems.

The Section for Electrochemistry works closely with Sections for Catalysis, Inorganic Materials Chemistry, and Solid-state Physics and Quantum Technology within the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN), which provides access to a broad range of facilities with state-of-the-art instrumentation. 

The new associate professor is expected to take active part in and further develop these collaborations, and to make strategic use of this infrastructure in pioneering research on functional materials, photo- and electrocatalysis, and technology development within sustainable energy conversion. Computational materials science has taken a central role in the section’s activities, alongside extensive use of synchrotron facilities through the Swiss-Norwegian Beamlines (SNBL) at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facilities (ESRF).

The Section for Electrochemistry currently has two permanent faculty members and plays a central role in research and education in materials science and electrochemistry, with a strong focus on sustainable energy technologies. To consolidate and further develop the section’s activities in research, supervision and teaching, we seek to employ a new associate professor who will strengthen and expand our efforts in electrochemical energy conversion and related areas, and who will contribute the section’s development both in depth and in new directions.


More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in physical or inorganic chemistry or materials science and have a strong scientific track record within the area of photo/electrocatalysis.
  • A strong track record and/or a clear potential for research that will lead to technology development. 
  • Scientific qualifications will play a major role, and the main emphasis will be on the candidate’s scientific production from the last five years.
  • Documented potential for acquisition of external funding
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, equivalent to B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. A track record in scientific and administrative leadership is an advantage.
  • International network, outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to create a good working environment will be part of the evaluation.
  • The person appointed will be requested to take on some administrative duties. Hence such experience will be an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 880 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
u io.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.
If you have an i mmigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. 

As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Forandringsstærk teamleder, der lykkes i fællesskab
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at forme og understøtte Efter- og Videreuddannelsesområdet på Absalon? Vi søger en udviklingsorienteret teamleder, der kan omsætte ambitioner til resultater og skabe følgeskab i forandringer. Du skal kunne navigere mellem forskellige interesser og faglige perspektiver, være nysgerrig og lyttende – og samtidig have gennemslagskraft til at holde fast i retningen, når det er nødvendigt.

Du bliver en del af et tæt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvor du sammen med en erfaren teamlederkollega skal stå i spidsen for et nyt samlet team og skabe endnu stærkere sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og den samlede udvikling af vores efter- og videreuddannelsesområde.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der kombinerer stærke ledelseskompetencer og en udviklingsorienteret tilgang. Området er komplekst, og derfor er der brug for god, sammenhængende ledelseskraft ind i området. Du skal sammen med en teamlederkollega lede EVU-teamet som et stærkt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvilket sætter store krav til samarbejde, stærke relationer og kommunikation. Sammen skal I skabe sammenhæng mellem de store ambitioner for området og hverdagens udfordringer. For at lykkes i dette er det væsentligt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Dine relationelle kompetencer er helt i top. Til hverdag vil du få en bred samarbejdsflade med medarbejdere og ledere på tværs af Absalon. Din evne til at etablere relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige kolleger er afgørende. Du har et stærkt strategisk perspektiv og med din gode gennemslagskraft, evner du at udvikle driften ud fra den strategiske linje.

Du har erfaring med styring af processer i en kompleks organisation. Det ligger dig naturligt at inddrage og samarbejde med relevante samarbejdspartnere i organisationen. Du er processtærk og har erfaring med at gennemføre udviklings- og forandringsprocesser i en kompleks organisation. Du har et helhedsblik og evner at procesplanlægge, optimere arbejdsgange, dataunderstøtte og udarbejde objektivt begrundede beslutningsoplæg. Du er optaget af både udvikling og implementering i hverdagspraksis.

Du har ledelseserfaring. Din ledelsesstil er inddragende, nysgerrig og dialogorienteret, og du formår at motivere samarbejdspartnere og medarbejdere mod fælles mål. Du har erfaring med at lede udviklingsprocesser, styre projekter og involvere de rette interessenter. Du spiller din lederkollega god, bringer egne perspektiver tydeligt i spil og kan stå på fælles beslutninger. Som personaleleder er du optaget af at styrke trivslen hos den enkelte medarbejder og teamet som helhed.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har kendskab til eller interesse for uddannelsessektoren
  • kommunikerer enkelt og præcist på skrift
  • har en relevant uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du skal forvente, at du vil have opgaver, der knytter sig til følgende ledelsesroller: strategisk ledelse, drifts – og faglig ledelse, personaleledelse og - udvikling samt udvikling af dig selv og din måde at lede på. Konkrete arbejdsopgaver der skal løses, vil bl.a. være:

Udvikling af EVU-området. Vi har høje ambitioner for Absalons efter- og videreuddannelse og vi står over for en spændende udvikling, hvor både samarbejdsformer, processer og opgaveløsning skal udvikles. Sammen med din lederkollega skal du være med til at professionalisere understøttelsen af det samlede EVU-område og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og organisationens strategiske ambitioner. Det indebærer bl.a. udvikling af tydelig governance, stærkere beslutningsgrundlag baseret på data og sikker implementering af nye løsninger.

Kvalitetssikring af leverancer. I den daglige drift er det vigtigt, at du mestrer at driftslede, prioritere opgaveløftet og sikre den løbende dialog med uddannelsernes konsulenter og ledere, samt følger konstruktivt og systematisk op på tilbagemeldinger m.v.

Personaleledelse. Som personaleleder er du tillidsfuld og sikre rammerne for god trivsel i teamet. Derudover har du fokus på at skabe højt engagement, hvor opgavernes og samarbejdets formål er klart defineret. Du skal skabe overblik og tydelige rammer for medarbejdernes arbejde samt for opgavefordelingen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Uddannelsesservices EVU-team, hvor vi dataunderstøtter, udvikler og administrerer efter- og videreuddannelse. Teamet består af mange forskellige fagligheder, og vi er tilsammen 20 medarbejdere. Din lederkollega og du vil begge have personaleledelse for hver jeres medarbejdergruppe, og tilsammen vil I have fælles ansvar for teamets opgaveløft og det strategiske ledelsesansvar.

Uddannelsesservice har 5 teams. Vi håndterer også al optagelse, administration og vejledning af studerende på vores professionsbachelor- og ingeniøruddannelser. Tilsammen er vi 94 kolleger i Uddannelsesservice, som er en velfungerende og uhøjtidelig afdeling, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores kontorer ligger side om side med undervisningslokaler, og vi arbejder tæt på de studerende og tæt med hinanden. Vi vægter kollegial trivsel højt og har brug for, at du også er en holdspiller. Vi har en uformel omgangstone og har mange bolde i luften, som vi gør os stor umage med at gribe.

Vi holder til på vores Campus i Slagelse, som er nemt at komme til, da det er placeret lige ved stationen. Absalon har en dejlig frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse hurtigst muligt
  • Du kan forvente et lønniveau på 700.000 kr. - 800.000 kr. årligt inkl. pension.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Chef for Uddannelsesservice Randi Mølager på telefon 7248 1280.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” til højre på denne side senest den 1. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 5.oktober og 2. samtale den 8. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner – og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.description:
**General Mission**

The Coordinator is responsible for the development and programming of the library. They organise activities and events, develop partnerships, and contribute to the librarys visitor numbers.

They are also responsible for monitoring the collections, handling returned books, and keeping the library organised.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Library Programming and Development**

- Promote the librarys spaces and collections by developing projects and events.

- Develop a range of paid activities and services.

- Manage the library shop and coffee area.


**2\. Talks and Debates**

- Identify and invite authors, experts, associations and other relevant speakers or personalities.

- Encourage discussion, participation and interaction among different audiences.


**3\. Partnerships and Collaborations**

- Identify, develop and maintain a network of partners.

- Build partnerships and joint projects with external organisations and stakeholders.


**4\. Library Space and Collection Management**

- Handle returned books and ensure that materials are properly shelved and organised.

- Maintain the collections, including classification, presentation, repairs and replacement of damaged or missing items.

- Select and order new books and other materials.


**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, independent and curious person who is proactive and enjoys interacting with the public. The successful candidate will play an active role in the cultural and commercial development of a welcoming and open community space.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence in interacting with the public and partners.

- Ability to create and develop partnerships.

- Initiative and ability to propose and deliver projects.

- Commercial awareness and ability to identify potential sources of funding.

- Strong organisational skills, autonomy and versatility.

- A passion for reading, discussion and the exchange of ideas.


**Practical Information**

- Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, renewable

- Working hours: 80%, spread over 4 days per week

- **Salary :** €2,268 gross per month

- Start date : October 2026

- Languages: English at C1 level required; French at B2 level preferred; Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Junior PMO / Change Management Consultant, Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Junior PMO & Change Management Consultant, you will support a critical business transformation project. Working closely with the Project Manager, you will ensure smooth day-to-day execution, coordinate stakeholder validation, and drive end-user training and adoption. This role is ideal for an energetic professional looking to build trust and deliver impactful change.

Work tasks

This role blends project coordination, PMO support, change management, and training coordination to drive successful project delivery and solution adoption.

 
- PMO & Project Coordination: Assists the Project Manager with daily execution, meeting orchestration, action tracking, and cross-functional workstream alignment
- Stakeholder Engagement & Validation: Coordinates business testing, gathers cross-geographic feedback, and proactively escalates risks or project delays
- Change Management & Communication: Drives end-user change readiness, crafts project messaging, addresses user concerns, and serves as an advocate for end-user needs
- Training & Adoption: Plans and manages the training stream, creates learning materials, tracks readiness, and measures solution adoption to ensure long-term engagement

We are looking for

- Relevant work experience
- Good organizational and project coordination skills
- Good communication and stakeholder management capabilities
- Basic experience facilitating workshops and meetings
- Advanced proficiency in written and verbal English
- Proactive, energetic, and relationship-building mindset

Other information:

Start: As soon as possible

Employment period: Until the end of 2026

Location: Helsinki, hybrid working model

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

In English:

About Lomac A/S
Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.
We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.

We offer

  • Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
  • Modern machinery and good working conditions
  • Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
  • Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
  • A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development


Job content

  • MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
  • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
  • Quality control of your own work
  • Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlines


We expect that you

  • Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
  • Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
  • Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
  • Can work independently and as part of a team
  • Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented


Requirements for applicants

  • Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
  • Can communicate in English and/or German
  • Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)

  • Number of positions: 10–15

  • Employment type: Permanent position
  • Working model: Rotation scheme – employees work a set period in Denmark, followed by a period at home, before returning to Denmark. The preferred rotation is 4 weeks of work followed by 2 weeks off. Travel to and from Denmark is at the employee’s own expense.
  • Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
  • Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour
  • Overtime: We follow the current overtime pay rules of the Confederation of Danish Industry
  • Employee benefits: Housing and work clothing is provided
  • Collective agreement: Employment conditions are based on the applicable Collective agreement with the Confederation of Danish Industry (DI).

Jonas Nielsen, Business Coordinator
Lomac A/S

How to apply
Send your application and CV to jni@lomac.dk As soon as possible.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

jobs.title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
jobs.description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

- Helping customers and explaining our menu and products

- Sales and recommending products to customers

- Serving food and drinks

- Keeping the dining area clean and organized

- Cleaning tables and restaurant areas

- Other daily restaurant tasks


We expect you to have:

- At least **1–2 years of customer service experience**

- Excellent and friendly **customer service skills**

- A genuine desire to help customers and create a great customer experience

- A **sales-oriented mindset** and the ability to recommend products naturally

- Good **stress tolerance and ability to work under pressure**

- **Quick problem-solving skills** and the ability to make decisions independently

Working hours

Employment

jobs.title: Distance Technologies: Data Collection Driver
jobs.description:
**Type:** Part-time, fixed term

**Location:** John Stenbergin ranta 2, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 1.10.2026

Drive, collect real-world data and help develop next-generation technology designed to make vehicles safer and smarter.

**What will you be doing?**

Distance Technologies is looking for a part-time Data Collection Driver to support the development of its next-generation display technologies. Your main responsibility is to drive a Distance-provided car and collect camera and sensor data in different environments around the capital area. The data is used by Distances R&D teams to develop technologies such as depth estimation, positioning, and latency compensation, so your drives might take you from city streets and highways to forest roads in varying conditions.

Based on requests from the engineering team, you will plan suitable routes, operate pre-made data collection scripts from a laptop, and verify that the cameras and sensors are working properly. During the drive, you will troubleshoot basic technical issues independently, such as Wi-Fi, cable, USB device or storage problems. After each drive, you will check and upload the recordings and document the driving conditions and any unexpected events.

**What makes you a great fit?**

This role suits you if you are looking for a flexible part-time role, where you can combine driving with an interest in technology and gain experience in a real R&D environment. The role can fit well alongside technical studies, but relevant skills and curiosity may just as well come from work experience, projects or hobbies.

You are comfortable with computers, enjoy solving practical problems and can work independently based on technical instructions. What matters is a reliable approach to driving, technical curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**We expect you to have:**

- A valid Category B driving license and responsible driving skills

- Recent and regular driving experience in both urban environments and varying road conditions in Finland

- Good computer skills and confidence following technical instructions

- Ability to troubleshoot basic issues with Wi-Fi, USB devices, cables, storage and similar equipment

- Reliable and independent approach to your work

- Good English skills


**We consider as an asset:**

- Familiarity with Linux

- Experience with cameras, lenses, focusing, sensors, or similar equipment

- Basic scripting skills, such as automating a file transfer

- Familiarity with computer vision or related technologies


**We can offer you:**

- Chance to build valuable technical experience in a flexible entry-level role that can fit alongside your studies or other commitments

- Opportunity to join a growing deep tech company developing new technology for global automotive and defense applications

- Environment to improve vehicle safety, seeing how the data you collect contributes directly to its development

- Hands-on experience with advanced cameras, sensors, and test equipment while learning how deep tech products are developed

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers, giving you practical exposure to computer vision and sensor development


**Practicalities:**

This is a part-time (16-32,5h/month) and fixed term position until 31.1.2027. Working hours are flexible and agreed based on data collection needs. As data collection depends on suitable weather conditions, scheduled shifts may occasionally need to be rescheduled at short notice due to weather. We therefore hope that you are flexible regarding working days and hours. In this role you will be employed directly as a aTalent employee at Distance Technologies. Start time is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki. Salary in this position is 18,00-22,00 €/hour depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- Initial interviews with aTalent: week 41

- Interview rounds with Distance Technologies: week 42

- Final decisions and selections: week 43

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing & Communications team in Helsinki and shape how customers discover, engage with, and experience Bluefors across digital channels. In this role, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to strengthen our digital presence, develop demand generation, and turn marketing activities into measurable commercial impact. Interested? Keep reading!

You will take ownership of Bluefors' digital marketing activities, channels, technologies, and performance. As a member of the Marketing & Communications team, you will help ensure that customers can easily discover and engage with Bluefors through a connected digital ecosystem. Working closely with Sales, other customer-facing teams, and IT, you will plan and optimize campaigns, develop our website and social media presence, and use analytics to continuously improve engagement, conversion, and marketing effectiveness.

We are looking for a data-driven digital marketing professional who can translate business and commercial priorities into clear actions. You combine a strong understanding of digital channels with experience in marketing automation, lead management, campaign execution, and performance measurement. You are comfortable working across teams and systems, can move between strategic planning and practical implementation, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Success in this role requires curiosity, collaboration, and a strong continuous improvement mindset. You actively seek opportunities to improve ways of working, enhance digital performance, and create better customer experiences.

Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, AI-enabled marketing tools, and agency or technology partner management would be an additional asset. This experience can help you accelerate the impact of our digital marketing activities and contribute to the continued development of our digital ecosystem.

We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position with the support of a highly skilled growth organization. This is an excellent opportunity to build a scalable digital marketing ecosystem and grow professionally in a dynamic and collaborative team. Our multicultural work environment gives you room to develop your skills and make a visible impact on Bluefors commercial growth.

Main responsibilities:

* Develop and execute Bluefors digital marketing strategy in line with business, marketing, and commercial objectives.

* Plan, manage, and optimize campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels.

* Own and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing, lifecycle communications, and related processes.

* Act as Marketings key user and primary business stakeholder for Salesforce CRM and related commercial systems.

* Oversee website performance, social media channels, SEO, generative engine optimization, analytics, conversion, and user experience.

* Establish KPIs and reporting processes, turning performance data into actionable recommendations.

* Develop digital marketing systems, integrations, data flows, platform governance, and AI-enabled capabilities.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and manage relevant agencies, technology partners, and service providers.

What we expect from you

* Minimum 10 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong track record in areas such as marketing automation, campaign execution, and digital performance measurement, supported by relevant education

* Experience with CRM platforms, marketing technologies, campaign automation, lead management, and customer engagement processes.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and insights into actions that support commercial objectives.

* Strong understanding of digital channels, website management, SEO, performance marketing, and digital campaign execution.

* Ability to work effectively across teams and systems and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution and drive initiatives from concept to implementation.

* A curious and collaborative mindset combined with a strong focus on continuous improvement and optimizing performance, processes, and customer experiences.

* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

We also appreciate

* Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments.

* Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, and AI-enabled marketing tools.

* Experience managing agencies, technology partners, or external service providers.

Please apply as soon as possible, on October 18, 2026 at the latest, through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM [http://BLUEFORS.COM]. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information, please contact our Director, Marketing & Communications, Ingela Waismaa, ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com [ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com]. Ingela can also be reached at +358 50 5306603 during the following times: Sept. 28, 08:00-09:00, Sept. 29, 17:00-18:00 and Oct. 13, 09:00-10:00.

jobs.description:
Viktiga arbetsuppgifter för en eventsäljare inom hotellspa

Arbetet innebär att sälja hotellets boende-, mötes- och evenemangstjänster främst till företagskunder och grupper.

Bearbeta och förhandla offertförfrågningar, beräkna, erbjuda och sälja företagsmötes- och evenemangspaket samt bokningar för stora gruppmedlemmar.

jobs.title: Java FX & C++ Developer
jobs.description:
For our client in the banking sector, we are looking for a back-end developer with knowledge in C++ and Java FX. The team is responsible for creating automated credit decisioning solutions for all business lines.

Role expectations:
- Taking responsibility for the full lifecycle of application development
- Working on integrations, utilising middle-tier frameworks
- Cooperating with business to clarify expectations
- Testing, both manual and automated
- Reviewing the code on a regular basis and initiating needed improvements, and refactoring
- Maintaining technical documentation
- Good communication skills and willingness to take responsibility

Must-have knowledge and experience:
- 6+ years of experience as a backend developer
- Knowledge and experience in C++, Springboot, Microservices and Java is a must
- Familiarity with tools such as Maven, Bamboo, Jenkins, GIT and Jira - Knowledge and ability to use Clean Code principles
- Experience within Agile development methodologies- Fluent in spoken and written English 

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
- Knowledge of automation frameworks such as Selenium and Cucumber
- Knowledge of COBOL, JCL, DB2, VB and ASP will be seen as an advantage
- Experience with Kubernetes container deployment
- Proficiency in Finnish language because some of the codebase is in Finnish
- Prior experience in the financial services industry
- Worked with AI for developing solutions to create business value

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have at least 6 years of professional experience as a backend developer?*
- Do you have hands-on experience developing production applications in both Java (Java 8+) and C++?*
- Have you worked with Spring Boot and Microservices in a professional environment?*
- Do you have experience with CI/CD and development tools such as Maven, Git, Jenkins, or Bamboo?*
- Have you worked in Agile/Scrum development teams and participated in code reviews and refactoring activities?*
- Do you have previous experience working in the banking, financial services, or credit decisioning domain?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately

Location: Helsinki, Finland (hybrid)
Allocation: 100 %
Start date: 1.10.2026
End date: 30.3.2027, possible continuation
Language: Fluent in English, Finnish is an advantage

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
jobs.description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Arctic Skylight Lodge is a hotel opened in 2020, located less than 5 km from the center of Äkäslompolo. The surroundings are unique, as all our buildings are situated in the middle of the forest. We offer 10 glass cabins, a glass-walled restaurant with 22 seats, and a stunning riverside sauna with an outdoor hot tub, featuring views of the river and the possibility for ice swimming throughout the winter.

The restaurant serves breakfast for hotel guests, lunch, and in the evenings a three-course menu. We are looking for a Head Chef to join our team someone with the skills to create delicious and beautifully presented dishes for our guests. We expect flexibility, resilience under pressure, and the ability to lead a small team. We require versatile experience, a self-directed approach to work, and strong problem-solving skills.

We hope you can design dishes that delight our guests and make them want to return. Our menu has traditionally included three starters, four main courses, and three desserts, with flavors ranging from Nordic tastes to Asian influences. There is also a possibility to work morning shifts.

The working language is mainly English. Work begins in November and lasts until the end of the season in April. Salary is negotiable depending on experience. Accommodation is provided and it is located 1,5km away from lodge.

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lab.fi

jobs.title: CNC Machine Setter / Operator
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Position: 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator Company: N & E Precision Engineering Location: Longford, Ireland Salary: €38 to €42K / annum Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Production Manager About the Role N & E Precision Engineering is seeking an experienced 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator to join our precision engineering team in Longford. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, proving out and operating CNC milling machines to manufacture high-precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications and quality requirements. The role will involve working with 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, with previous CNC programming experience being a significant advantage. Key Responsibilities • Set up and operate CNC milling machines, including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis equipment. • Prepare tooling, workholding, offsets and machine settings. • Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T requirements. • Program, edit and prove out CNC programs where required. • Manufacture precision components to the required quality standards. • Carry out first-off and in-process dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring equipment. • Make authorised program and offset adjustments where required. • Maintain accurate setup sheets, tooling lists and production documentation. • Identify and report machine, tooling or quality issues. • Maintain CNC machines and the working area in a clean, safe and organised condition. • Work closely with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. • Follow all company health and safety and quality procedures. Requirements • Previous experience as a CNC Setter / Operator in a precision engineering or manufacturing environment. • Experience with CNC milling and 4- or 5-axis machining. • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring equipment. • Good understanding of CNC tooling, offsets and machine setup. • CNC programming experience is a significant advantage. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Hours The successful candidate may be required to work either: • Day Shift: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm • Evening Shift: 4:30 pm – 1:00 am Shift allocation will depend on operational requirements Career Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced CNC professional to join a precision engineering environment and further develop their 5-axis machining, setup and programming skills. Candidates with previous aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. How to apply? Please forward CV to gustavo.cainelli@guspes.com Application Process: We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days. If you do not hear from us within this timeframe, please consider your application unsuccessful. We may contact you regarding future opportunities.

- vikojen selvittämisestä ja korjaamisesta

- uudisasennustehtävät

- ennakkohuoltojen toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä

- tuotannon toimintavarmuuden ylläpitämisestä.

- sähköalan ammattihenkilön pätevyyttä sähköturvallisuuslain mukaisesti

- valmiutta myös mekaanisen kunnossapidon tehtäviin

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentekyyn

- aikaisempaa kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta

- turvallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- työturvallisuuden huomioivaa työtapaa

- positiivista asennetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

- hygieniapassi on hyvä lisä


Työ on **kaksivuorotyötä (aamu- ja iltavuoro)**. Tehtävässä **ei ole päivystystä** ja **työt tehdään aina samassa tehtaassa**.

**Asiakkaamme tarjoaa sinulle** monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän nykyaikaisessa kunnossapitoympäristössä, mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi sekä suuren yrityksen henkilöstöedut. Turvallisuus on heillä aina etusijalla. Työt alkaa nopealla aikataululla jo lokakuun alussa.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Joroisiin
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Joroisen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.
