jobs.title: Project Manager, Industrial projects
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead industrial investment projects that contribute to a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Managers to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will manage demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from project development and engineering through implementation, commissioning and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
At Sweco, you will work closely with clients, contractors, system and equipment suppliers, designers and Swecos multidisciplinary project organisation. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for impactful projects while being supported by a strong network of experts.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and at least five years of experience in demanding industrial project delivery. This is not a discipline-specific project management role: you have experience leading broad, multidisciplinary project organisations and coordinating interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
You are able to manage the overall delivery of a complex industrial project, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, reporting and stakeholder collaboration. You can coordinate several technical disciplines and delivery partners, identify and resolve interface issues, and keep the project moving forward towards its objectives.
We expect you to have:
- At least five years of relevant experience in industrial project management or project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary industrial projects during the implementation phase; experience with EPCM or similar industrial project delivery models is an advantage.
- Understanding of industrial project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
- Strong stakeholder-management, communication and collaboration skills.
- Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is an advantage.

What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the role, salary or working at Sweco, please contact:
Ville Mykrä
ville.mykra@sweco.fi
Please submit your application through the application form. Due to GDPR requirements, we do not process or store job applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

We are looking for a practical, ambitious, and reliable professional who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership in an international environment.

**Required qualifications**

- A degree or professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Computer Science, IT, or a comparable technical field.

- Hands-on experience with electrical, automation, control, or industrial IT systems, including confidence in using technical tools, test equipment, and diagnostic software.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify faults across hardware, software, electrical, and control systems.

- Practical experience with low- or medium-voltage equipment and the ability to read electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.

- Professional working proficiency in Finnish and English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and international colleagues.

- Willingness to travel up to 30%, including occasional short-notice assignments. Some commissioning and service activities may take place outside standard working hours.

- A valid Category B driving licence and willingness to travel independently to customer sites.

- Ability to manage assigned service and commissioning tasks independently while collaborating effectively with international engineering, project, and customer support teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to provide professional technical support, guidance, and updates.

- A proactive and responsible approach, with strong quality awareness, customer focus, and ownership of assigned tasks.


**Preferred qualifications**

- Previous experience as a Field Service Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, System Engineer, Service Technician, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.

- Experience with airport systems, airfield lighting, industrial infrastructure, or other safety- or operationally critical systems.

- Practical knowledge of PLC systems, switchgear, control equipment, and industrial automation.

- Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux operating systems.

- Working knowledge of SQL databases, including basic diagnostics, queries, and system support.

- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages used for diagnostics, configuration, automation, or system integration, such as Python, Bash, batch scripting, C#, or JavaScript.

- Experience with cloud-connected systems, remote monitoring solutions, networking, or remote support tools.

- A relevant Finnish electrical safety qualification. Candidates who are eligible and willing to obtain the required qualification may also be considered.

- Knowledge of other European languages.


**What We Offer**

At **ADB SAFEGATE**, you will join an innovative industry leader where your work directly contributes to safer and smarter airport operations worldwide.

**We offer:**

- A role in a global company setting benchmarks in airport safety, efficiency, and technology.

- A dynamic work environment with challenging and meaningful projects.

- International cooperation with experienced colleagues and customers.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and modern working models.

- The friendly atmosphere of a medium-sized company combined with the strength of a global organization.

- Opportunities for personal development, technical training, and professional growth.

- Opportunities to work on customer projects in Finland and across Europe.

- A varied, practical, and engaging role where no two days are the same.


**Ready to Help Airports Move Smarter?**

If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on fieldwork, and want to be part of an international team delivering critical airport solutions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join ADB SAFEGATE and help shape the future of safe, efficient, and sustainable airport operations.**

jobs.title: On It Films: Gameplay Capture Producer
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Ruoholahti, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 06.10.2026

On It Films, an in-house video partner for Supercell, is looking for a full-time Gameplay Capture Producer to join their gameplay capture team and help keep the capture process running smoothly from request to final delivery.

**About the role**

As a Gameplay Capture Producer, youll sit at the intersection of gameplay capture, post-production and clients. Youll be responsible for coordinating the schedules and priorities of seven Gameplay Capture Artists and making sure capture requests are understood and prepared correctly.

Youll work closely with the Head of Gameplay Capture, who leads the team and supports you in your work. The environment moves fast, with multiple projects running in parallel and deadlines changing quickly, so keeping production aligned and ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time is key.

**What youll do**

- Manage the production schedule for Gameplay Capture Artists based on project priorities, deadlines, artist availability and project needs, while maintaining a sustainable workload.

- Coordinate gameplay capture requests from start to finish, ensuring the team has the necessary information, game builds, instructions and references.

- Act as the communication bridge between Gameplay Capture, Post Production and clients, keeping schedules, requirements, priorities and potential issues aligned.

- Work closely with Post Producers to turn upcoming needs into practical capture plans and identify bottlenecks or conflicts before they impact production.

- Work directly with clients, helping clarify their requests, priorities and delivery expectations.

- Develop workflows, processes, documentation and communication together with the Head of Gameplay Capture.


**What makes you a great fit?**

Youre a strong communicator who works well with people and knows how to keep a busy production moving. Youre comfortable juggling priorities and making sure everyone has what they need to do great work.

Your background could be in game development, gameplay capture, video or post-production, VFX or animation. You dont need to know all of these inside out – what matters is the curiosity to learn the rest.

**You should have**

- Relevant experience across a mix of game development, gameplay capture, video and post-production workflows – we dont expect you to know them all.

- Strong communication skills in English across teams and clients. Whats important is the ability to translate technical or production-related information between different teams, making sure everyone understands not only what is happening, but also why it matters.

- Strong production coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple projects moving and balance changing priorities, deadlines and team capacity.

- A genuine interest in games and curiosity to learn more about game development and gameplay capture.


**Youll be especially good at this role if you**

- Have hands-on understanding of gameplay capture and what it takes to get the right material into post-production.

- Have experience working directly with game studios and clients.

- Have a good understanding of games, gaming terminology and how games are made.

- Experience working across complex production pipelines and understanding how small changes can have a wider impact later in the process.

- Are familiar with Supercell games and the kind of gameplay capture and video production On It Films does.


**On It Films can offer you**

- Autonomy in your work, with close support from the team.

- A skilled, inspiring and welcoming team of 40+ video professionals

- Excellent environment for growth and development

- A sustainable and healthy working environment

- Great office facilities at Supercell

- Comprehensive benefits package


**Practicalities**

This is a full-time and permanent position where youll be employed by On It Films. The preferred start date would be 1st of December 2026, but this is negotiable. Your work location will be at the office in Ruoholahti, Helsinki. Youll be based on site most of the time, but once youre more familiar with the work and comfortable making independent decisions, occasional work from home is fine. Salary in this position is approximately 4500 €/month according to your skills and experience.

**Excited to keep things moving at On It Films?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter by the latest Tuesday 6th of October 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/383566/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. Please note, that this position is located in Finland and requires a valid work permit in Finland.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

Learn more about On It Films here: https://onitfilms.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Senior Recruitment Consultant Kati Hautakoski (+358 50 552 0419, kati.hautakoski (at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability.



We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit.




YOU WILL:

 - Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance, enabling proactive issue detection.

 - Define and Drive Reliability Standards: Work with product and engineering teams to define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to monitor and report on these metrics, holding teams accountable and ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed.

 - Lead Incident Management and Response: Act as a senior leader during high-impact incidents, guiding the team to rapid resolution. Conduct thorough, blameless post-mortems and drive the implementation of preventative measures. Develop and refine runbooks and build automation to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

 - Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect, build, and improve automation to eliminate toil and operational work. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios.

 - Optimize Performance on Kubernetes: Collaborate with core infrastructure and product teams to performance-tune and optimize our large-scale cloud deployments, with a deep focus on Kubernetes, Docker, and GCP. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions.

 - Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose.

 - Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs.

 - Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture.

 - Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 8-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (e.g., DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering).

 - Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. You write high-quality, well-tested code.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture.

 - Deep experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

 - Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated monitoring and observability solutions (e.g., metrics, logging, tracing).

 - Strong incident management skills with extensive experience leading incident response for complex systems and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management tools.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and simply and a bias toward open, transparent cultural practices.

 - Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working with and mentoring engineers from junior to principal levels.

 - A willingness to dive into understanding, debugging, and improving any layer of the stack.

 - You're passionate about making software creation accessible and empowering the next generation of builders.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools.

 - Expert-level knowledge of modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

 - Experience designing and building reliable systems capable of handling high throughput and low latency.

 - Significant experience with Go and Terraform.

 - Familiarity with working in rapid-growth, startup environments.

 - Experience writing company-facing blog posts and training materials.

jobs.title: Bilmekaniker
jobs.description:
Vi søker en dyktig og selvstendig bilmekaniker. Stillingen passer for deg som trives med praktisk arbeid, liker å løse tekniske utfordringer og ønsker variert arbeid.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Fagbrev som bilmekaniker eller relevant erfaring fra verksted

  • Gode ferdigheter i feilsøking og bruk av diagnoseverktøy

  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert og effektivt under tidspress

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og serviceinnstilling

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Feilsøking og reparasjon på personbiler og varebiler

  • Service og vedlikehold etter produsentens anbefalinger

  • Diagnose ved hjelp av elektronisk utstyr

  • Montering og justering av bremsesystemer, styring, drivlinje og understell

  • Dokumentasjon av utførte arbeider og rapportering til oppdragsgiver

Vi tilbyr

Vi vurderer søkere fortløpende

Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Analyst (Commercial Projects & Financial Analysis), Uusimaa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Some experience in analyst roles (e.g., from consulting, advisory, corporate finance, or M&A)
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Please note that a security clearance will be conducted for the chosen candidate, and any offer of employment is conditional upon a successful security clearance check.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

If you’re an experienced chef who is ready to take the next step, take responsibility in the kitchen and potentially become a permanent part of the team, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Project Director, Industrial projects
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead complex industrial investment projects that shape a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Directors to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will lead demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from early project development through execution and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
As a Project Director, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of large and demanding industrial investment projects, or broader project portfolios. You will lead the project at a strategic and commercial level, from early project development through execution, commissioning and handover.
We are looking for senior professionals with strong experience in leading project delivery, building high-performing project organisations and working closely with clients and partners. At Sweco, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on major industrial investments together with leading experts across disciplines.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and 10+ years of experience in senior project leadership roles. You have a proven track record of successfully delivering industrial investment projects and strong experience in EPCM, PMC, Owner's Engineering or similar industrial project delivery environments.
You are an experienced project leader with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, build and develop high-performing project organisations, and manage complex interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning. You are comfortable leading large project organisations, managing schedules, budgets, risks and commercial matters, and working effectively with clients and diverse stakeholders.
You communicate and negotiate confidently in English; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage.
Experience from projects within process industries, energy, manufacturing, mining, chemicals and data centres is particularly valued.
What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the role, salary or working at Sweco, please contact:
Ville Mykrä
ville.mykra@sweco.fi
Please submit your application through the application form. Due to GDPR requirements, we do not process or store job applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
jobs.description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Vil du være med å skape trygghet på veiene?
jobs.description:
Ramudden søker nå flere trafikkmedarbeidere til vår avdeling i Drammen. 

Trives du i en aktiv hverdag med mye utfordringer og variasjon i arbeidet? Setter du sikkerhet og folka først? Vi ser etter trafikkmedarbeidere som kan hjelpe oss å vokse videre og møte etterspørselen fra våre kunder i tiden fremover.

Vi bistår våre kunder med alt innenfor trafikksikkerhet, og du vil få mulighet til å være tett på både små og store vei-, vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter i hele Buskerud.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver 

  • Dirigere trafikk og bidra til trygg ferdsel ved vei- og anleggsarbeid
  • Ledebilkjøring
  • Montering av midlertidig sikring
  • Transportoppdrag
  • Forvarslingsvogn
  • Skilting

Vi har også monteringsoppdrag tilknyttet bygg, anlegg, tunneldrift og ulike vakt- og beredskapsoppdrag. Vi er ofte involvert i større publikumsarrangementer i området, så her er det stor variasjon og ingen dag er lik! 

 

Hvem vi søker

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring og utdanning. Har du erfaring fra bransjen, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du tar sikkerhet på alvor og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og rutiner som bidrar til at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss innebærer et viktig ansvar for sikkerheten til både kolleger, trafikanter og andre som ferdes på og langs norske veier. 

Kvalifikasjoner: 

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE og C er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Bestå AVK 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse, men du må bestå dette for å kunne jobbe ute på veien)
  • Av sikkerhetsårsaker og dokumentasjonskrav må du kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Benytte telefon og ulike digitale systemer i din arbeidshverdag

Personlige egenskaper: 

  • Har godt humør og bidrar positivt i møte med både kunder og kolleger
  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, med høyt fokus på sikkerhet og dokumentasjon.
  • Er fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid og kan jobbe både dag, kveld og natt
  • Er praktisk og teknisk anlagt
  • Trives med en fysisk arbeidshverdag som innebærer å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

 

Vi kan tilby 

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden, lokalt og nasjonalt
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som passer godt for deg som trives med varierte arbeidstider
  • 30-60 % stilling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi gleder oss til å få flere nye kolleger med på laget, og håper du er en av dem!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
jobs.description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!


Kelpoisuusvaatimus:
Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja. Lisäksi valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2. mom. tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

About Utmost International
Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

Following an end-to-end Client due diligence review the primary role of the team is to clear any gaps while improving quality and achieving compliance with current and future regulatory standards.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Act as the person of contact for partner and client queries received by email, post or by telephone in respect of client data management,
• Take the necessary action to respond in an effective, professional and timely manner to the queries received by telephone, email or post from partners, clients or sales colleagues consistently ensuring a high level of service,
• Perform accurate and timely processing of the receipt of client data and query resolution relating to the management of client data, including document management, review of information and update of our Data Management system,
• Assist in processing the due diligence review of transactions in line with corporate and regulatory standards,
• Assist in contacting Partners and Clients to collect up to date data information and document collected through the KYC process,
• Assist in contacting clients using mass mailing and other client outreaching tool,
• Assist in communicating to Partner and Client on corporate initiatives,
• Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with our sales consultants and all partners,
• Maintain an ongoing awareness of services, review procedures and ensure quality improvements are made as required.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our KYC Officer?

• A minimum of 2 years experience working within the financial/insurance sector,
• Aware of developments within the financial/insurance sector in general,
• Knowledge of Compliance and AML regulation in the Life insurance sector,
• Experience in AML/KYC remediation or with client due diligence,
• You enjoy working in a challenging, fast paced environment and look for the opportunity to excel in all aspects of your role;
• Take personal pride in delivering high quality service to internal and external clients,
• Strong prioritisation skills and flexible, reliable and responsible in challenging situations,
• A team player with excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills (verbal and written) with active listening skills,
• Ability to work independently while keen to work as part of a team and assist colleagues,
• Ability to demonstrate a high level of initiative and problem-solving capabilities,
• You will be self-motivated with a high level of attention to detail, ability to understand client requirements and to develop relevant solutions,
• Willing to make the extra effort as required,
• Fluency in English is required. Spanish, Dutch, French, and Portuguese ae considered an advantage.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.
We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.

Governance, Regulatory and Compliance continues to be a complex business challenge. As new laws and regulations are introduced, companies' management needs to ensure that corporate governance standards are adhered to and that robust compliance management systems are in place, especially as non-compliance with regulatory requirements is under increased scrutiny from regulators.
In a period of heightened regulatory scrutiny and continuing globalization of AML/CTF regulation, organizations are faced with greater challenges to achieving and maintaining their AML/CTF compliance.

Our Forensic & AML services team, part of our Advisory department is advising clients on how to deal with and meet these regulatory challenges, assisting them in their efforts to prevent, detect and respond to money laundering, corruption and fraud issues.

• Solid understanding of Luxembourg and international AML/CTF regulatory framework

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

Localisation : Lintgen, Luxembourg

Le poste est actuellement basé sur notre site de Lintgen, au Luxembourg, avec un déménagement en cours vers notre nouveau site industriel 4.0 à Bissen, conçu pour offrir un environnement de travail moderne et pensé pour le confort de nos collaborateurs.

Vous apporterez votre expertise technique aux équipes commerciales et aux clients, les accompagnerez dans la conception et la sélection de solutions adaptées et assurerez le lien entre les équipes commerciales, les clients et les différents départements internes.

Support technique et accompagnement commercial

Support clients et interventions terrain

Formation et transmission des connaissances

Expertise réglementaire et connaissance du marché

Collaboration et amélioration continue

    Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Marketing, Product Management et Sales afin de développer des contenus techniques destinés aux supports promotionnels et à l'information des clients


Votre profil

jobs.title: Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)

Job Description

As Head of Marketing and Communications, you are accountable for shaping, amplifying, and protecting the firm's strategic priorities, growth agenda, and market positioning. Working closely with Executive Leadership, Business Development, and Sector Leads, you translate business strategy into compelling narratives, integrated go-to-market approaches, and high-impact marketing and communications activity.You lead the end-to-end marketing and communications agenda, spanning brand, reputation, digital, campaigns, events, internal communications, and employer branding. You explore and embed AI-enabled, insight-driven ways of working across all activities to deliver measurable commercial, reputational, and engagement impact.

AI is reshaping how clients discover expertise, consume content, engage with the firm, and make buying decisions, while also transforming the speed, skills, controls, and operating model required within Marketing and Communications. The role must therefore lead a deliberate shift in ways of working—redesigning processes rather than simply adding tools, strengthening data and content governance, building AI literacy and adoption across the team, and maintaining human judgement, creativity, brand integrity, and accountability.

This transformation must be closely connected to Business Development, sector priorities, and the firm's growth agenda, using AI and market insight to identify opportunities, sharpen propositions, personalise engagement, accelerate go-to-market activity, and improve pipeline conversion and commercial impact.

What you will be working on

Strategy, Planning & Leadership

• Translate business priorities into integrated marketing and communications plans.
• Partner with Business Development and Sector Leads to support growth, demand generation, and pipeline development.
• Drive governance, prioritization, and performance measurement across all marketing activities.
• Ensure consistent brand positioning, messaging, visual identity, and storytelling.

External Communications & Reputation

• Lead media relations, public relations, executive communications, and thought leadership.
• Support firm-wide initiatives and manage reputational risks.

Digital Marketing, Campaigns & Demand Generation

• Develop and execute digital, social media, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.
• Oversee SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Use data and insights to optimize performance and commercial impact.

Events, Sponsorships & Partnerships

• Lead strategic events, sponsorships, memberships, and partnerships that enhance brand visibility and client engagement.

Internal Communications & Employer Brand

• Drive internal communications and employee engagement initiatives.
• Partner with HR to strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
• Ensure alignment between employee experience and external reputation.

AI, Transformation & Operations

• Embed AI capabilities across marketing and communications to improve insight, creativity, efficiency, and effectiveness.
• Redesign processes and operating models to support AI-enabled ways of working.
• Ensure appropriate governance, quality control, compliance, and data protection.

Financial & People Leadership

• Own the marketing and communications budget and resource allocation.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team.
• Build capabilities in digital marketing, analytics, AI, and storytelling.
• Manage agency and vendor relationships.

What we look for

• Significant leadership experience (minimum 15 years) across Marketing and Communications, ideally within professional services, financial services, or another complex, regulated, knowledge-led environment.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy into impactful marketing and communication plans.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders.
• Extensive experience in brand management, communications, content strategy, and storytelling.
• Strong expertise in digital marketing, campaigns, social media, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Commercial and data-driven mindset, with the ability to demonstrate business impact.Experience leading transformation, change management, and AI adoption initiatives.
• Knowledge of GDPR and communications compliance requirements.Proven people leadership skills with experience building high-performing teams and fostering collaboration.
• Native English level. Additional languages relevant to Luxembourg's international environment are an asset.

Skills and Experience

Strategic Leadership

• Proven ability to translate business strategy into measurable marketing and communications plans
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Brand and Creative Direction

• Deep experience in brand positioning, creative briefing, content strategy, and storytelling, constantly pushing for creative ways to push the brand while adhering to brand guidelines where necessary.

Digital Marketing and Analytics

• Hands-on expertise in SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, social platforms, and analytics
• Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to connect activity to commercial impact

Operational Excellence

• Budget ownership, vendor and agency management, contract negotiation, and scalable process design

Regulatory Awareness

• Familiarity with GDPR and professional services compliance requirements

Leadership and Collaboration

• Proven people leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and change management capability

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our People Process Outsourcing (PPO) team within Human Capital, where specialists support clients with payroll, immigration and HR administration through a secure digital platform tailored to Luxembourg requirements. You will work closely with payroll experts, HR specialists and international colleagues to deliver compliant and efficient people processes for local and cross-border workforces.
What your role will look like

As a Payroll & HR Administration Associate, you will contribute to the accurate delivery of payroll and HR administration services for a portfolio of clients. Your role helps organisations stay compliant with Luxembourg and international requirements while ensuring employees receive a reliable and seamless payroll experience.

• Deliver end-to-end payroll calculations, including salary, bonuses, benefits, pension contributions, meal vouchers and other compensation components, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
• Prepare and coordinate monthly payroll reporting and declarations with tax and social security authorities.
• Manage payroll-related interactions with Luxembourg authorities, including the CCSS, CNS, ACD and ITM.
• Support the onboarding and payroll implementation of new clients, helping establish efficient and compliant processes from day one.
• Guide clients through their HR administration obligations and provide practical support on day-to-day people processes.
• Advise clients on payroll and HR compliance matters, including situations involving cross-border employment arrangements.
• Collaborate with colleagues across payroll, tax and HR disciplines to deliver consistent and high-quality client outcomes.
Your growth and opportunities
Develop your expertise in Luxembourg payroll legislation while gaining exposure to cross-border employment, tax and social security topics. Over time, you will take ownership of increasingly complex client situations and contribute to onboarding projects and process improvements. You will also strengthen your digital and advisory capabilities through close collaboration with specialists across the team.

The skills you bring

• Bachelor's degree with 1–2 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree in Management, Human Resources, Payroll Administration, Tax Law or a related field.
• Experience or strong exposure to payroll administration and HR-related processes.
• Microsoft Excel: Proficient / Independent use for payroll calculations, data analysis and reporting.
• Microsoft Word: Proficient / Independent use for documentation and client communications.
• Fluency in English and French

Ways of working

• You analyse information logically, identify patterns in payroll and HR data, and use sound judgement to resolve issues accurately.
• You collaborate effectively with colleagues, clients and stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes and deliver a consistent service experience.
• You actively seek opportunities to learn, adapt to new regulations and technologies, and continuously improve the way work is delivered.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Encouragement to apply

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Contribute to payroll and HR solutions that help organisations operate with confidence and compliance. Build your expertise alongside specialists who value quality, collaboration and continuous learning while supporting clients across Luxembourg and beyond. Grow here. Go further.

jobs.title: MLAĐI/A PROCESNI/A RADNIK/CA
jobs.description:
Organizacijska jedinica: Proizvodnja, Postrojenje za proizvodnju AN/KAN 2 Opis poslova:
  • Sudjelovanje u primopredaji smjene s procesnim radnikom iz prethodne smjene
  • Obilazak postrojenja, očitavanje procesnih parametara, unošenje podataka u radne liste

  • Upisivanje rezultata dnevnih analiza javljenih iz Kontrole kvalitete
  • Informiranje smjenovođe o uočenim poremećajima i kvarovima u procesu proizvodnje
  • Poduzimanje korektivnih aktivnosti u cilju normalizacije procesa u suradnji sa smjenovođom i iskusnijim procesnim radnikom
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u rukovanju opremom na radnom mjestu u startu, normalnom radu i zaustavljanju postrojenja
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u preventivnom pregledu opreme, vizualna zapažanja
  • Uzimanje uzoraka pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • Primjena pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • Održavanje čistoće na svom radnom mjestu
  • Određivanje pH taline amonijevog nitrata, određivanje koncentracije amonijevog nitrata i uzimanje uzoraka u trećoj smjeni pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Održavanje prohodnosti slivnih limova ispod transportera granulacijskog tornja i održavanje čistoće svih odvodnih kanala u postrojenju
  • Održavanje čistoće (prikupljanje rasutog proizvoda) svih transportera i ostalih uređaja u postrojenju
  • Pranje fluidizacijskog hladnjaka, čišćenje i pranje sita i drobilice, čišćenje i pranje sustava za povratnu frakciju
  • Uključivanje sustava za aminizaciju proizvoda pod stručnim nadzorom (čišćenje dizni, prepumpavanje amina)
  • Rukovanje kompresorom pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Sudjelovanje u obavljanju održavalačkih radova za vrijeme remonta i zastoja postrojenja te obavljanje manjih održavalačkih radova za vrijeme normalnog rada postrojenja te sudjelovanje u poslovima preventivnog održavanja po potrebi
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima
Uvjet:
  • SSS – strojarski, elektrotehnički ili kemijsko tehnološki smjer
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo u struci.
Traženi profil kandidata:
  • izražene organizacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.
Nudimo Vam:
  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnicu) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora I odlukama Uprave
  • uslugu prehrane u restoranu unutar tvorničkog kruga
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.
Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 27.9.2026. godine. U prijavi obavezno naznačiti radno mjesto za koje se prijavljujete. Više o nama saznajte na www.petrokemija.hr

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

 - Scale Experience: Experience supporting sales teams through hypergrowth phases, including building legal processes that scale with rapid revenue expansion

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
