Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to end-user devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools and approved business applications.

- Fulfil service requests (software installation/configuration, access requests, equipment requests) following standard procedures and security policies.

- Support user onboarding/offboarding: account setup coordination, workstation readiness, and user guidance on core tools and security best practices.

- Use remote support tools to assist users; collaborate with local IT/field services when hands-on intervention is required.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate resolver groups (workplace, network, server, security, applications) with clear diagnostics and evidence.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and troubleshooting guides; contribute to reducing repeat incidents.

- Maintain accurate asset and user device records in Freshservice and ensure data quality for reporting and compliance.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, providing status updates and setting expectations throughout the resolution process.

- Participate in shift coverage and (where applicable) on-call/major incident support according to the Global Service Desk operating model.

- Backfill the field service desk technician on request.


WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS POSITION

**Must have Experience/Skills:**

- Bachelor's degree in IT (or equivalent professional experience).

- 2+ years in a Service Desk / IT support role in an international environment.

- Demonstrated experience working with ITSM processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) and SLAs.

- Strong troubleshooting skills on Windows and common end-user hardware/peripherals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Familiarity with identity and access concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID), MFA and basic security hygiene.

- Experience with remote support tools and endpoint management basics (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM) is advantageous.

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, WiFi, VPN, connectivity troubleshooting).

- Excellent customer service mindset; ability to prioritize and work under time pressure.

- Fluent in Finnish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.


**Nice to have Experience/Skills:**

- Hands-on experience with Freshservice (or equivalent ITSM tool) including knowledge article creation.

- ITIL Foundation certification or practical ITIL experience.

- Experience supporting Teams telephony / conferencing room equipment.

- Exposure to regulated environments (GxP) and validated processes.

jobs.title: Perhefutiksen ja kerhojen ohjaaja
jobs.description:
Laajasalon Palloseura on helsinkiläinen vuonna 1978 perustettu 1000 pelipassipelaajan ja lähes 1500 harrastajan jalkapalloyhteisö, jonka pääasiallisena toiminta-alueena on Laajasalon saari ja sen lähiympäristö.

Etsimme ohjaajia perhefutikseen, lasten jalkapallokerhoon ja aikuisten jalkapallokouluun.

Voit olla taustaltasi vaikka liikunnanohjaaja, fysioterapeutti, liikunnanopettaja, urheilija tai valmentaja. Pääasia on, että saat ohjaamasi ryhmän innostumaan liikkumisesta ja motivoitumaan liikunnasta ja jalkapallosta.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 

OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityis Norway's third-largest university, with 23,000 students and more than 2,600 employees. We have campuses in central Oslo and the Romerike region. Our research and education address the needs of working life, the welfare state, and the wider metropolitan region.

 

For more than 200 years,OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityhas contributed to building the knowledge and expertise that underpin the Norwegian welfare state. Today, OsloMet is a modern, urban university with strong academic environments in teacher education, health and social sciences, social research, design, and technology.

jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

Lisäksi monipuolisiin tehtäviin kuuluu kassatyötä sekä tuotteiden järjestelyä ja myymälän yleistä siisteyden ylläpitoa. Etsimme joukkoomme asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntihenkistä tekijää, joka aidosti nauttii myynnistä ja motivoituu tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta. Olet tiimipelaaja, joka tuo ympärilleen positiivista energiaa ja kannustaa myös muita onnistumaan. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö vaihtelevissa vuoroissa. jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer for CAM Plant Project, Kotka
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our clients China HarbourEngineering Company Ltd. team for the Kotka CAM Plant project.

China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd. (CHEC) is a world-renowned international contractor and a leading provider of comprehensive services across the entire industrychain for both public and private sectors. CHEC has been engaged as the main contractor for the CAM Plant project in Kotka, responsible for the implementation and construction of the plant.

In this Electrical Engineer role, you will be part of the MEP team that contributes to thesuccessful execution of the project. The position is project-based, with an expected duration of 6-12 months and the work is located in Keltakallio, Kotka.

Your responsibilities include:

- Supervising Electrical installations on site.
- Coordinating electrical design work across disciplines and review key construction and design plans.
- Leading the construction drawing review process and provide post-design technical services.
- Resolving on-site electrical technical issues and support project implementation.
- Reviewing electrical documents for procurement and subcontracting.

What we expect from you:

- Bachelor's or masters degree in electrical engineering.
- Experience in electrical design, review, and/or construction support.
- Familiarity with Finlands electrical laws, codes, and engineering procedures.
- Experience working in multicultural teams.
- Skilled in technical document review, site coordination, and drawing approvals.
- Proficiency in CAD, Revit, and Office software for design and reporting tasks.
- Full professional proficiency in English.

The desired start date for the job is as soon as possible according to the agreement.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process or the role, please contact BaronaEngineering Senior Consultant Katri Hyppänen at +358 50 439 9785. Available on Mondays,Tuesdays and Thursdays from 10 am to 2 pm.

We will be interviewing applicants during the application period, so please apply for the position through the provided link. Kindly attach your English-language CV to your application. For privacy reasons, we do not accept applications via email or WhatsApp.

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelupäällikkö, Antell Gateway, Vantaa
jobs.description:
Haemme lounasravintolaamme iloista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja aurinkoisen asiakaspalvelutaidon omaavaa Asiakaspalvelupäällikköä.

Haemme tehtävään moniosaajaa, jolla on vahva ammattitaito ja ymmärrys sekä keittiön että salin toiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat asiakaspalvelu, salaattien ja lämpimien lisäkkeiden valmistaminen, vitriini- ja salaattituotteiden valmistamista, kassatyöskentelyä, astiahuoltoa, inventointia, raaka-aineiden tilaamista ja sekä muita ravintoloan yleisiä tehtäviä. Työskentelet toimipisteessä yksin.

Toivomme, että sinulla on tehtävään sopiva koulutus ja vahva kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Odotamme, että olet asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntihenkinen, ja haluat olla mukana kehittämässä ravintolan toimintaa ja palvelua.

Sinulla löytyy intohimoa ja näkemystä hyvän ruoan ja palvelun tekemiseen sekä asiakaslähtöistä että taloudellista ajattelutapaa. Sinulla on myös loistavat vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot asiakkaiden kanssa toimimiseen. Sinulla on hyvä paineensietokyky, ja olet tottunut työskentelemään nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa, kiireenkin keskellä. Pystyt kommunikoimaan asiakkaiden kanssa sujuvasti suomen ja englannin kielellä. Keittiötuntemus katsotaan eduksi. Edellytämme hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työtehtävän, ja saat tueksesi lämminhenkisen ja välittävän työyhteisön. Innostumme teknologioista, jotka auttavat arjessamme, joten saat ammattitaitosi rinnalle myös nykyaikaiset työkalut. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

- monipuolisen päivätyön herkullisia makunautintoja hakevien asiakkaiden parissa
- osaamisen ja tehtävänmukaisen palkan, palkitsemme myös onnistumisista
- liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hierontaedun
- lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon 24/7
- työvaatteet ja työkenkätuen
- mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja koulutuksiin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa aluepäällikkö, yhteystiedot löydät ilmoituksen alaosasta.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille hakemuksesi sekä ansioluettelosi. Huomioithan, että aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Antell tekee aidosti hyvää! Antell tarjoaa herkullisia makunautintoja noin 60:ssä lounas- ja henkilöstöravintolassa ympäri Suomen. Arjen iloisten lounashetkien lisäksi tarjoamme asiakkaillemme ihania makuja ja elämyksiä kokouksissa ja muissa tilaisuuksissa. Haluamme olla mukana rakentamassa asiakkaidemme hyvinvointia. Osaamisemme ytimessä on monipuolinen, hyvää tekevä ja herkullinen ruoka. Syyskuusta alkaen olemme osa Sodexo-konsernia.

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description:
**Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!**

**Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.**

**Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**

Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.

Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.

**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**

Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.

**Mitä edellytämme:**

- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla.

- Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.

- Motivaatio oppia palvelut ja tuotteet sekä kyky toimia tavoitteellisesti ja vastuullisesti.

- Tavoitteellisuutta ja innokkuutta suoramyyntiä kohtaan.

- Kyky toimia itsenäisesti, suunnitella ja toteuttaa työtehtäviä ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen jälkeen.

- Kokemusta asiakastyötä tai itsenäistä tekemistä sisältävistä rooleista.

- Käytännön valmiudet ottaa asiakaskohtaamiset ja päätöksenteko hallintaan kenttätyössä.

- Turvasuojaajakortin edellyttämä nuhteettomuus rikosrekisterissä. Neuvomme kortin hankinnassa aina työsuhteen alkaessa.


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Kannustavan palkkamallin, maksamme noin 300€/kauppa provisioista. Keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat noin 3000-5000€ / kk, ja parhaiten tienaavat yltävät 10 000€ / kk tai sen yli.

- Takuupalkan 2000€/kk työsuhteen kolmena ensimmäisenä kuukautena, joka koostuu 500€ pohjapalkasta ja 1500€/kk takuuprovisiosta. Tuemme alkuvaiheen onnistumistasi maksamalla korotettuja provisioita työn ensimmäisten kuukausin aikana.

- Käyttöetuauton, jolla pääset liikkumaan sekä työ- että vapaa-ajalla.

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen koko työsuhteesi aikana. Aloitat työsi neljän päivän koulutuskurssilla toimistolla, jonka jälkeen perehdytys jatkuu kentällä yhdessä kouluttajien sekä esihenkilösi kanssa. Katso Youtube kanavaltamme (Verisure Suomi) videoltakouluttajamme Peterin esittely siitä, miten koulutamme sinut tehtävään.

- Miellyttävän ja välittävän työyhteisön. Olemme myös tutkitusti hyvä työnantaja. Meille on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Lisäksi sijoituimme Suomen parhaat työpaikat -gaalassa keskisuurten yritysten kategoriassa.

- Yhteistä tekemistä ja paljon erilaisia tapahtumia. Pääset esimerkiksi tutustumaan sekä näkemään eri kaupungeissa työskenteleviä myyjiä koko firman myyntitapahtumien yhteydessä, tai nauttimaan koko organisaatiolle järjestettävässä Inspiration Day –kesätapahtumassa.

- Myyntikilpailuja, joista voit voittaa mm. Ulkomaanmatkoja. Katso tästäInstagram tililtämme video myyjiemme palkintomatkasta Saksaan.

- Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi – tällä hetkellä lähes jokainen kenttämyynnin esihenkilö on edennyt tehtäväänsä talon sisältä. Katso tarinoita urasivuiltamme sekä sosiaalisen median tileiltämme.

- Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten käyttöetuauto, kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä, hammaslääkärietu, lounasetu, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut.


Pääset tutustumaan meihin sekä Verisuren myyntityöhön tarkemmin sosiaalisen median tiliemme kautta TikTokissa ja Instagramissa @verisurelaiset.

**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**

Verisuren myyjänä seisot ylpeästi tuotteesi takana ja turvaat samalla ihmisten kodit sekä yritystilat suomen suosituimmalla sekä luotetuimmalla kodinturva-alan palvelulla. Lähetä hakemus tehtävään sivulla olevasta linkistä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuaikana, ja paikat täytetään aina sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi.

jobs.title: Researcher in Applied Mineralogy
jobs.description:
About the position and project

The Natural History Museum (NHM) at the University of Oslo invites applications for a two-year, full-time position as a Researcher in applied mineralogy and industrial mineral exploration. The position will be based in the Department of Research and Collections, within the Norwegian Centre for Mineralogy Research Group. The position is part of the innovation industry-research project “PureQ – The Future of the High-Purity Quartz Value Chain for Improved Yield, Quality and Sustainability”, funded by the Research Council of Norway.

The successful and highly motivated candidate will have a strong publication record and demonstrated experience with modern, advanced microanalytical techniques for mineral characterisation, particularly of quartz. Relevant expertise includes crystal chemistry and microtextural characterisation. Experience in mineral exploration, especially geochemical exploration and drill-core logging, is also desirable.


Qualifications requirements 

Required qualifications:
•    A PhD in geology or mineralogy
•    Demonstrated ability to conduct elemental microanalysis using LA-ICP-MS, including data processing and interpretation
•    A recent publication record relevant to the subject area of the position
•    A strong upward academic trajectory

The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of English as working language. Proficiency in Norwegian is an advantage.

Desirable qualifications:
•    Familiarity with a range of microanalytical and spectrometric techniques used for mineral analysis besides LA-ICP-MS, such as SEM, EPMA, and CL


Personal qualities
  • High motivation to work at the interface between academia and industry
  • Ability to meet project reporting deadlines consistently 
  • Willingness to travel frequently within Norway and abroad as part of the project
  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive, and productive research environment
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other staff members
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Building networks within the national geoscience and mineral industry sectors
  • Onboarding program for new employees
  • Good welfare schemes, in addition to Oslo´s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities 
  • Salary in position as Researcher (position code 1109) in salary range NOK from 620 000 to 720 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter

jobs.description:
Salaire: 45000 - 50000

Notre client est une startup luxembourgeoise innovante, spécialisée dans le cloud souverain. Elle accompagne les PME de tous secteurs dans leur transformation numérique, en mettant l'accent sur la sécurité, la performance et l'agilité. L'entreprise connaît une forte croissance, et recrute aujourd'hui pour renforcer son équipe technique un(e) :

INGÉNIEUR CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE (H/F)
CDI - LUXEMBOURG SUD - A PARTIR DE 45K€

Sous la responsabilité du Lead Architect, vous serez en charge de l'exploitation et de l'évolution d'une plateforme cloud certifiée ISO 27001, ainsi que des services qu'elle héberge. Vous interviendrez sur trois dimensions clés : l'exploitation technique, la conception d'architectures d'hébergement et le pilotage de projets de migration.

Vos principales missions :

*

   Exploitation & évolution de la plateforme : assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, la supervision, l'automatisation et l'évolution de la plateforme Cloud, ainsi que la gestion des incidents, changements et astreintes.

*

   Architecture & solutions Cloud : analyser les besoins clients, concevoir des solutions d'hébergement adaptées et contribuer aux propositions techniques et à l'évolution de l'offre Cloud.

*

   Sécurité & conformité : contribuer à la sécurisation des infrastructures, au suivi des événements de sécurité et au maintien de la certification ISO 27001.

*

   Projets & relation client : piloter les projets de migration et de mise en production, accompagner les clients et revendeurs et assurer la documentation des solutions.

De formation Bac+2 à Bac+5 en informatique, vous disposez de 5 ans minimum d'expérience en administration systèmes Linux. Une expérience en environnement Cloud, hébergement ou infrastructure est un réel atout.

Environnement technique :

*

   Systèmes : Linux (Debian, Ubuntu)

*

   Cloud & Virtualisation : Apache CloudStack, KVM

*

   Conteneurisation & Orchestration : Docker, Kubernetes

*

   Automatisation & Infrastructure as Code : Ansible, Terraform, Bash, Python

*

   SIEM & Sécurité : Wazuh, OpenSearch

*

   Supervision, sauvegarde & exploitation : outils de supervision et de sauvegarde

La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est indispensable. Toute autre langue constituera un plus apprécié.

Savoir-être : Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et curieux, avec un bon sens des responsabilités. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme clients. Vous êtes à l'aise pour documenter, formaliser et apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies.

Vous avez une appétence pour accompagner des collaborateurs juniors et les faire monter en compétences.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa kasvua, luomassa asiakkaille todellista lisäarvoa ja tekemässä tulosta alan johtavien ratkaisujen parissa?

Etsimme energiseen myyntitiimiimme Sales Engineeriä, joka innostuu aktiivisesta asiakastyöstä, uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta ja kaupallisten onnistumisten rakentamisesta. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään laajan ja korkeatasoisen turvatekniikan tuote- ja ratkaisutarjoomamme parissa sekä vaikuttamaan suoraan asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Sales Engineerinä työskentelet myynnin etulinjassa monipuolisessa roolissa, jossa yhdistyvät uusasiakashankinta, nykyisten asiakkuuksien kehittäminen sekä asiakaslähtöisten ratkaisujen rakentaminen.

Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita, sparraat heitä löytämään parhaat ratkaisut ja viet myyntimahdollisuuksia määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta aina onnistuneeseen kauppaan asti. Hyödynnät työssäsi moderneja digitaalisia myyntityökaluja ja vastaat omien myyntikokonaisuuksiesi hallinnasta sekä tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä, kun**

- nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä

- osaat tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita ja muuttaa ne toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi

- haluat kehittyä jatkuvasti ja oppia uutta turvatekniikan ratkaisuista

- viihdyt yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, kollegoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- viet asioita aktiivisesti maaliin ja pidät huolen sovittujen tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta


Et ole yksin. Tukenasi on asiantunteva ja kannustava tiimi, modernit työkalut sekä vahva organisaatio, jossa onnistumisia rakennetaan yhdessä.

**Miksi tämä tehtävä?**

Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan omaan menestykseesi, asiakkaiden kokemukseen sekä koko myyntiorganisaation tuloksiin. Myyntityön lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus osallistua toimintatapojen ja prosessien kehittämiseen sekä olla mukana rakentamassa tulevaisuuden menestystarinaa.

Jos sytyt myynnistä, asiakasarvon luomisesta ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee Hedengrenin uudella pääkonttorilla Ruoholahdessa. Työskentelemme hybridimallilla etä ja lähityötä yhdistellen. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja esihenkilönäsi toimii myyntitiimistä vastaava.

**Odotamme sinulta**

- Vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemusta myyntitehtävistä

- Kokemusta B2B-myynnistä talotekniikka-alalta

- Kokemus uusasiakashankinnasta katsotaan eduksi

- Hyvää organisointikykyä, itsenäistä työskentelyotetta ja yhteistyökykyä

- Järjestelmällistä ja pitkäjänteistä työotetta sekä kiinnostusta myös rutiininomaisiin tehtäviin

- Kokemusta CRM-järjestelmien ja digitaalisten myyntityökalujen hyödyntämisestä, sekä vahvaa Microsoft 365 osaamista (Microsoft Dynamics katsotaan eduksi)

- Turvatekniikan sekä sähkötekniikan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa; ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

- AMK-tasoinen tai vastaava koulutus katsotaan eduksi


**Miksi Hedengren?**

Tarjoammemahdollisuuden työskennellä osana vakavaraista, vastuullista ja jatkuvasti kehittyvää suomalaista perheyritystä, jolla on vahva asema alalla.Hedengrenillä viihdytään hyvin. Tästä kertovat hedengreniläisten pitkät työurat perinteikkäässä, mutta kehittyvässä ja uudistuvassa perheyhtiössä. Arvomme – korkea liiketoimintaetiikka, avoimuus uudistumiselle ja vastuullisuus – ohjaavat päivittäistä työtämme ja toivomme niiden myös inspiroivan sinua.

Hyvinvointisi on meille tärkeää ja tarjoammekin erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten laadukkaan työterveyshuollon, Epassin lounas- ja hyvinvointiedut ja joustavat työajat.

Työnantaja sairastaa Ms-tautia ja liikkuu pyörätuolilla. Työnantaja on pitkä ja roteva. Avustajalla täytyy olla voimaa, että jaksaa auttaa siirtymisissä ja suoriutuu työtehtävistä. Tärkeintä on työnantajan liikkeiden auttaminen työnantajan ohjeiden mukaisesti.

Työtä tarjotaan n. 20–30 h/vko. Työvuorot pääsääntöisesti arkisin, työvuorot n. klo 5–8 tunnin pituisia. Työvuoroja satunnaisesti myös viikonloppuisin.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu siirtymisissä, pukeutumisessa, ruuan laitossa, ruuan lämmityksessä ja kotihommissa avustamista. Työ sisältää koiran ulkoilutusta. Avustaja toimii kuskina asiointimatkoilla.

Palkkaus: Heta TES B1 13,73 €/h + mahdolliset kokemuslisät

Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan/avustettavan edunvalvojaan.

Haastatteluun / työsuhteeseen valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.

Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä. Avustajan odotetaan ymmärtävän, että työtä tehdään työnantajan arjessa hänen ohjeistuksiensa ja toiveiden mukaisesti.

Avustajan pitää olla fyysisesti hyvässä kunnossa suoriutuakseen työstä. Avustajalla tulee olla ajokortti, hyvä ajotaito ja maalaisjärkeä, huumorintajusta, kärsivällisyydestä ja joustavuudesta on hyötyä. Englannin kielen taito on välttämätön. Kokemus henkilökohtaisena avustajana toimimisesta on äärimmäisen iso bonus.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen havu.keskus@hyvaks.fi. Liitä hakemukseesi tämän työpaikkailmoituksen oma viitetieto. Välitämme hakemuksesi työnantajalle.

jobs.description:

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Cyber Security Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

The Cyber Security Manager will be responsible for cyber security governance, compliance, and product security across Vard Electro's portfolio. You will drive our cyber roadmap, ensure compliance with industry regulations, and contribute to the development of secure products and cyber-related services.

 

  • Own and maintain Vard Electro's cyber security roadmap.
  • Ensure compliance with IACS UR E26/E27, IEC 62443, EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and other relevant standards, laws, rules and regulations.
  • Lead Cyber Type Approval and cyber certification activities with classification societies.
  • Define and manage cyber security requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support Product Managers and development teams in implementing secure-by-design principles.
  • Drive supplier and supply chain cyber security requirements.
  • Identify and develop new cyber security products, services, and commercial offerings.
  • Lead and develop the Cyber Security team.
  • Potentially assume product management responsibility for future cyber security products and services
Qualifications

  • Experience with cyber security in IT and/or OT environments.

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and IACS E26/E27.
  • Experience with cyber risk assessments, secure product development, and certification processes.
  • Experience with team management

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We at Rocsole are experts in electrical tomography and its application to industrial process monitoring. Our unique SeeBeyond technology helps customers detect and visualize liquids, solids, and interfaces in demanding industrial environments. Our LiquiDetect and SoliDetect products support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our customers include major industrial and energy companies around the world.

We are looking for an **Automation Engineer** to join **#TeamROCSOLE**!

In this position, you will create and maintain electrical and automation documentation for Rocsole products, including wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and other related technical documentation. You will provide technical support throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to customer projects, commissioning activities, troubleshooting, and after-sales support together with Rocsoles Technical Support team.

You will work closely with our product development, production, and technical support professionals. Your responsibilities will include supporting electrical and functional testing, maintaining accurate product documentation, and ensuring that product modifications are properly reflected in drawings and technical materials.

You will also participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. When required, you will support customers remotely or on-site. Occasional international travel is therefore part of the role.

The right candidate is a structured and detail-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working independently, but you also collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take pride in producing accurate technical documentation and providing professional support in practical engineering situations.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

- Creating and maintaining wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and related technical documentation for Rocsole products

- Ensuring that electrical documentation meets Rocsoles quality standards, applicable requirements, and customer needs

- Updating drawings and documentation when product modifications and engineering changes are implemented

- Supporting production personnel with electrical and automation-related technical issues

- Supporting electrical and functional testing of products before shipment

- Participating in verification and validation activities for new products and product modifications

- Supporting commissioning and startup activities together with Rocsoles Technical Support Specialist

- Participating in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT)

- Providing remote and on-site technical support when required


**We expect you to have:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical field

- Relevant work experience in electrical schematic and wiring diagram design

- Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, DraftSight, or equivalent electrical design tools

- Basic knowledge of PLCs and automation systems

- Strong attention to detail and a structured, systematic approach to your work

- Good problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills

- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Willingness to travel internationally on occasion


Equivalent competence acquired through relevant work experience may also be considered.

**The following will be considered an advantage:**

- Experience in designing and documenting 230 VAC industrial electrical systems

- A valid SFS 6002 Electrical Safety Training certificate

- Knowledge of the SFS 6000 electrical installation standards

- Experience with industrial instrumentation and sensors

- Experience with industrial communication networks

- Understanding of Ex, ATEX, or IECEx requirements


Our company embraces personal and professional growth. If you are looking for practical engineering challenges and an opportunity to develop your expertise in industrial automation, instrumentation, and sensor technology, this could be the right place for you.

Our office is located in Kuopio, Finland, where your workstation and colleagues are waiting for you. The position is full-time and permanent. Occasional international travel is required.

**We shape the future of industrial process monitoring. Come join us! More info at: https://rocsole.co/AutEng**

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Master's thesis. If your thesis has not yet been completed, upload a draft version.
  • Documentation of English proficiency The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of ENglish language proficiency has been submitted
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
jobs.description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

jobs.title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
jobs.description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. Våre motorer er kjent for kvalitet og pålitelighet, og har en ingeniørtradisjon som strekker seg tilbake til 1855 da Bergen Mekaniske Verksted (BMV) ble etablert. Bedriften bygde sin første dieselmotor i 1946, og siden den gang har over 7500 motorer blitt levert der over halvparten fortsatt er i drift i dag. Tidligere kjent som Rolls-Royce Bergen Engines, ble bedriften en del av det britiske, privateide ingeniørselskapet Langley Holdings plc. 31. desember 2021.
